text_pt: Também todo o réptil, que se arrasta sobre a terra, será abominação; não se comerá.
text_el: καὶ πᾶν ἑρπετόν ὃ ἕρπει ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς βδέλυγμα τοῦτο ἔσται ὑμῖν οὐ βρωθήσεται

text_en: Whatsoever goes upon the breast on four feet, or has many feet, or trails on the earth, you shall not eat, because it is abominable.
text_la: Quidquid super pectus quadrupes graditur, et multos habet pedes, sive per humum trahitur, non comedetis, quia abominabile est.
text_pt: Tudo o que anda sobre o ventre, e tudo o que anda sobre quatro pés, ou que tem muitos pés, entre todo o réptil que se arrasta sobre a terra, não comereis, porquanto são uma abominação.
text_el: καὶ πᾶς ὁ πορευόμενος ἐπὶ κοιλίας καὶ πᾶς ὁ πορευόμενος ἐπὶ τέσσαρα διὰ παντός ὃ πολυπληθεῖ ποσὶν ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἑρπετοῖς τοῖς ἕρπουσιν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς οὐ φάγεσθε αὐτό ὅτι βδέλυγμα ὑμῖν ἐστιν

text_en: Do not defile your souls , nor touch aught thereof, lest you be unclean ,
text_la: Nolite contaminare animas vestras, nec tangatis quidquam eorum, ne immundi sitis.
text_pt: Não vos façais abomináveis, por nenhum réptil que se arrasta, nem neles vos contamineis, para não serdes imundos por eles;
text_el: καὶ οὐ μὴ βδελύξητε τὰς ψυχὰς ὑμῶν ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς ἑρπετοῖς τοῖς ἕρπουσιν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ οὐ μιανθήσεσθε ἐν τούτοις καὶ οὐκ ἀκάθαρτοι ἔσεσθε ἐν αὐτοῖς

text_en: for I am the Lord your God . Be holy because I am holy . Defile not your souls by any creeping thing, that moves upon the earth.
text_la: Ego enim sum Dominus Deus vester : sancti estote, quia ego sanctus sum. Ne polluatis animas vestras in omni reptili quod movetur super terram.
text_pt: Porque eu sou o Senhor vosso Deus; portanto vós vos santificareis, e sereis santos, porque eu sou santo; e não vos contaminareis com nenhum réptil que se arrasta sobre a terra;
text_el: ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν καὶ ἁγιασθήσεσθε καὶ ἅγιοι ἔσεσθε ὅτι ἅγιός εἰμι ἐγὼ κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν καὶ οὐ μιανεῖτε τὰς ψυχὰς ὑμῶν ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἑρπετοῖς τοῖς κινουμένοις ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: For I am the Lord , who brought you out of the land of Egypt , that I might be your God .
text_la: Ego enim sum Dominus, qui eduxi vos de terra Ægypti, ut essem vobis in Deum. Sancti eritis, quia ego sanctus sum.
text_pt: Porque eu sou o Senhor, que vos fiz subir da terra do Egito, para que eu seja vosso Deus, e para que sejais santos; porque eu sou santo.
text_el: ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι κύριος ὁ ἀναγαγὼν ὑμᾶς ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου εἶναι ὑμῶν θεός καὶ ἔσεσθε ἅγιοι ὅτι ἅγιός εἰμι ἐγὼ κύριος

text_en: You shall be holy , because I am holy . This is the law of beasts and fowls, and of every living creature that moves in the waters, and creeps on the earth:
text_la: Ista est lex animantium ac volucrum, et omnis animæ viventis, quæ movetur in aqua, et reptat in terra,
text_pt: Esta é a lei dos animais, e das aves, e de toda criatura vivente que se move nas águas, e de toda criatura que se arrasta sobre a terra;
text_el: οὗτος ὁ νόμος περὶ τῶν κτηνῶν καὶ τῶν πετεινῶν καὶ πάσης ψυχῆς τῆς κινουμένης ἐν τῷ ὕδατι καὶ πάσης ψυχῆς ἑρπούσης ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: That you may know the differences of the clean, and unclean , and know what you ought to eat, and what to refuse.
text_la: ut differentias noveritis mundi et immundi, et sciatis quid comedere et quid respuere debeatis.
text_pt: Para fazer diferença entre o imundo e o limpo; e entre animais que se podem comer e os animais que não se podem comer.
text_el: διαστεῖλαι ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν ἀκαθάρτων καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν καθαρῶν καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν ζωογονούντων τὰ ἐσθιόμενα καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν ζωογονούντων τὰ μὴ ἐσθιόμενα

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses , saying:
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:
text_pt: Falou mais o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: Speak to the children of Israel , and you shall say to them: If a woman having received seed shall bear a man child, she shall be unclean seven days, according to the days of separation of her flowers.
text_la: Loquere filiis Israël, et dices ad eos : Mulier, si suscepto semine pepererit masculum, immunda erit septem diebus juxta dies separationis menstruæ.
text_pt: Fala aos filhos de Israel, dizendo: Se uma mulher conceber e der à luz um menino, será imunda sete dias, assim como nos dias da separação da sua enfermidade, será imunda.
text_el: λάλησον τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτούς γυνή ἥτις ἐὰν σπερματισθῇ καὶ τέκῃ ἄρσεν καὶ ἀκάθαρτος ἔσται ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας κατὰ τὰς ἡμέρας τοῦ χωρισμοῦ τῆς ἀφέδρου αὐτῆς ἀκάθαρτος ἔσται

text_en: And on the eighth day the infant shall be circumcised :
text_la: Et die octavo circumcidetur infantulus:
text_pt: E no dia oitavo se circuncidará ao menino a carne do seu prepúcio.
text_el: καὶ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ὀγδόῃ περιτεμεῖ τὴν σάρκα τῆς ἀκροβυστίας αὐτοῦ

text_en: But she shall remain three and thirty days in the blood of her purification. She shall touch no holy thing: neither shall she enter into the sanctuary, until the days of her purification, be fulfilled.
text_la: ipsa vero triginta tribus diebus manebit in sanguine purificationis suæ. Omne sanctum non tanget, nec ingredietur in sanctuarium, donec impleantur dies purificationis suæ.
text_pt: Depois ficará ela trinta e três dias no sangue da sua purificação; nenhuma coisa santa tocará e não entrará no santuário até que se cumpram os dias da sua purificação.
text_el: καὶ τριάκοντα ἡμέρας καὶ τρεῖς καθήσεται ἐν αἵματι ἀκαθάρτῳ αὐτῆς παντὸς ἁγίου οὐχ ἅψεται καὶ εἰς τὸ ἁγιαστήριον οὐκ εἰσελεύσεται ἕως ἂν πληρωθῶσιν αἱ ἡμέραι καθάρσεως αὐτῆς

text_en: But if she shall bear a maid child, she shall be unclean two weeks, according to the custom of her monthly courses. And she shall remain in the blood of her purification sixty-six days.
text_la: Sin autem feminam pepererit, immunda erit duabus hebdomadibus juxta ritum fluxus menstrui, et sexaginta sex diebus manebit in sanguine purificationis suæ.
text_pt: Mas, se der à luz uma menina será imunda duas semanas, como na sua separação; depois ficará sessenta e seis dias no sangue da sua purificação.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ θῆλυ τέκῃ καὶ ἀκάθαρτος ἔσται δὶς ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας κατὰ τὴν ἄφεδρον καὶ ἑξήκοντα ἡμέρας καὶ ἓξ καθεσθήσεται ἐν αἵματι ἀκαθάρτῳ αὐτῆς

text_en: And when the days of her purification are expired, for a son, or for a daughter, she shall bring to the door of the tabernacle of the testimony , a lamb of a year old for a holocaust , and a young pigeon or a turtle for sin : and shall deliver them to the priest .
text_la: Cumque expleti fuerint dies purificationis suæ, pro filio sive pro filia, deferet agnum anniculum in holocaustum, et pullum columbæ sive turturem pro peccato, ad ostium tabernaculi testimonii, et tradet sacerdoti,
text_pt: E, quando forem cumpridos os dias da sua purificação por filho ou por filha, trará um cordeiro de um ano por holocausto, e um pombinho ou uma rola para expiação do pecado, diante da porta da tenda da congregação, ao sacerdote.
text_el: καὶ ὅταν ἀναπληρωθῶσιν αἱ ἡμέραι καθάρσεως αὐτῆς ἐφ' υἱῷ ἢ ἐπὶ θυγατρί προσοίσει ἀμνὸν ἐνιαύσιον ἄμωμον εἰς ὁλοκαύτωμα καὶ νεοσσὸν περιστερᾶς ἢ τρυγόνα περὶ ἁμαρτίας ἐπὶ τὴν θύραν τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου πρὸς τὸν ἱερέα

text_en: Who shall offer them before the Lord , and shall pray for her: and so she shall be cleansed from the issue of her blood. This is the law for her that bears a man child or a maid child.
text_la: qui offeret illa coram Domino, et orabit pro ea, et sic mundabitur a profluvio sanguinis sui : ista est lex parientis masculum aut feminam.
text_pt: O qual o oferecerá perante o Senhor, e por ela fará propiciação; e será limpa do fluxo do seu sangue; esta é a lei da que der à luz menino ou menina.
text_el: καὶ προσοίσει ἔναντι κυρίου καὶ ἐξιλάσεται περὶ αὐτῆς ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ καθαριεῖ αὐτὴν ἀπὸ τῆς πηγῆς τοῦ αἵματος αὐτῆς οὗτος ὁ νόμος τῆς τικτούσης ἄρσεν ἢ θῆλυ

text_en: And if her hand find not sufficiency, and she is not able to offer a lamb, she shall take two turtles, or two young pigeons, one for a holocaust , and another for sin : and the priest shall pray for her, and so she shall be cleansed.
text_la: Quod si non invenerit manus ejus, nec potuerit offerre agnum, sumet duos turtures vel duos pullos columbarum, unum in holocaustum, et alterum pro peccato : orabitque pro ea sacerdos, et sic mundabitur.
text_pt: Mas, se em sua mão não houver recursos para um cordeiro, então tomará duas rolas, ou dois pombinhos, um para o holocausto e outro para a propiciação do pecado; assim o sacerdote por ela fará expiação, e será limpa.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ μὴ εὑρίσκῃ ἡ χεὶρ αὐτῆς τὸ ἱκανὸν εἰς ἀμνόν καὶ λήμψεται δύο τρυγόνας ἢ δύο νεοσσοὺς περιστερῶν μίαν εἰς ὁλοκαύτωμα καὶ μίαν περὶ ἁμαρτίας καὶ ἐξιλάσεται περὶ αὐτῆς ὁ ἱερεύς καὶ καθαρισθήσεται

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron , saying:
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, et Aaron, dicens:
text_pt: Falou mais o SENHOR a Moisés e a Arão, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν καὶ Ααρων λέγων

text_en: The man in whose skin or flesh shall arise a different colour or a blister, or as it were something shining, that is the stroke of the leprosy , shall be brought to Aaron the priest , or any or of his sons.
text_la: Homo, in cujus cute et carne ortus fuerit diversus color, sive pustula, aut quasi lucens quippiam, id est, plaga lepræ, adducetur ad Aaron sacerdotem, vel ad unum quemlibet filiorum ejus.
text_pt: Quando um homem tiver na pele da sua carne, inchação, ou pústula, ou mancha lustrosa, na pele de sua carne como praga da lepra, então será levado a Arão, o sacerdote, ou a um de seus filhos, os sacerdotes.
text_el: ἀνθρώπῳ ἐάν τινι γένηται ἐν δέρματι χρωτὸς αὐτοῦ οὐλὴ σημασίας τηλαυγὴς καὶ γένηται ἐν δέρματι χρωτὸς αὐτοῦ ἁφὴ λέπρας καὶ ἀχθήσεται πρὸς Ααρων τὸν ἱερέα ἢ ἕνα τῶν υἱῶν αὐτοῦ τῶν ἱερέων

text_en: And if he see the leprosy in his skin, and the hair turned white and the place where the leprosy appears lower than the skin and the rest of the flesh: it is the stroke of the leprosy , and upon his judgment he shall be separated.
text_la: Qui cum viderit lepram in cute, et pilos in album mutatos colorem, ipsamque speciem lepræ humiliorem cute et carne reliqua : plaga lepræ est, et ad arbitrium ejus separabitur.
text_pt: E o sacerdote examinará a praga na pele da carne; se o pêlo na praga se tornou branco, e a praga parecer mais profunda do que a pele da sua carne, é praga de lepra; o sacerdote o examinará, e o declarará por imundo.
text_el: καὶ ὄψεται ὁ ἱερεὺς τὴν ἁφὴν ἐν δέρματι τοῦ χρωτὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἡ θρὶξ ἐν τῇ ἁφῇ μεταβάλῃ λευκή καὶ ἡ ὄψις τῆς ἁφῆς ταπεινὴ ἀπὸ τοῦ δέρματος τοῦ χρωτός ἁφὴ λέπρας ἐστίν καὶ ὄψεται ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ μιανεῖ αὐτόν

text_en: But if there be a shining whiteness in the skin, and not lower than the other flesh, and the hair be of the former colour, the priest shall shut him up seven days.
text_la: Sin autem lucens candor fuerit in cute, nec humilior carne reliqua, et pili coloris pristini, recludet eum sacerdos septem diebus:
text_pt: Mas, se a mancha na pele de sua carne for branca, e não parecer mais profunda do que a pele, e o pêlo não se tornou branco, então o sacerdote encerrará o que tem a praga por sete dias;
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ τηλαυγὴς λευκὴ ᾖ ἐν τῷ δέρματι τοῦ χρωτός καὶ ταπεινὴ μὴ ᾖ ἡ ὄψις αὐτῆς ἀπὸ τοῦ δέρματος καὶ ἡ θρὶξ αὐτοῦ οὐ μετέβαλεν τρίχα λευκήν αὐτὴ δέ ἐστιν ἀμαυρά καὶ ἀφοριεῖ ὁ ἱερεὺς τὴν ἁφὴν ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας

text_en: And the seventh day he shall look on him: and if the leprosy be grown no farther, and has not spread itself in the skin, he shall shut him up again other seven days.
text_la: et considerabit die septimo : et si quidem lepra ultra non creverit, nec transierit in cute priores terminos, rursum recludet eum septem diebus aliis.
text_pt: E ao sétimo dia o sacerdote o examinará; e eis que, se a praga, ao seu parecer parou, e na pele não se estendeu, então o sacerdote o encerrará por outros sete dias; 6
text_el: καὶ ὄψεται ὁ ἱερεὺς τὴν ἁφὴν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἑβδόμῃ καὶ ἰδοὺ ἡ ἁφὴ μένει ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ οὐ μετέπεσεν ἡ ἁφὴ ἐν τῷ δέρματι καὶ ἀφοριεῖ αὐτὸν ὁ ἱερεὺς ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας τὸ δεύτερον

text_en: And on the seventh day, he shall look on him. If the leprosy be somewhat obscure, and not spread in the skin, he shall declare him clean , because it is but a scab: and the man shall wash his clothes, and shall be clean .
text_la: Et die septimo contemplabitur : si obscurior fuerit lepra, et non creverit in cute, mundabit eum, quia scabies est : lavabitque homo vestimenta sua, et mundus erit.
text_pt: E o sacerdote ao sétimo dia o examinará outra vez; e eis que, se a praga se recolheu, e na pele não se estendeu, então o sacerdote o declarará por limpo; é uma pústula; e lavará as suas vestes, e será limpo.
text_el: καὶ ὄψεται αὐτὸν ὁ ἱερεὺς τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἑβδόμῃ τὸ δεύτερον καὶ ἰδοὺ ἀμαυρὰ ἡ ἁφή οὐ μετέπεσεν ἡ ἁφὴ ἐν τῷ δέρματι καθαριεῖ αὐτὸν ὁ ἱερεύς σημασία γάρ ἐστιν καὶ πλυνάμενος τὰ ἱμάτια καθαρὸς ἔσται

text_en: But, if the leprosy grow again, after he was seen by the priest and restored to cleanness , he shall be brought to him:
text_la: Quod si postquam a sacerdote visus est, et redditus munditiæ, iterum lepra creverit : adducetur ad eum,
text_pt: Mas, se a pústula na pele se estende grandemente, depois que foi mostrado ao sacerdote para a sua purificação, outra vez será mostrado ao sacerdote,
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ μεταβαλοῦσα μεταπέσῃ ἡ σημασία ἐν τῷ δέρματι μετὰ τὸ ἰδεῖν αὐτὸν τὸν ἱερέα τοῦ καθαρίσαι αὐτόν καὶ ὀφθήσεται τὸ δεύτερον τῷ ἱερεῖ

text_en: And shall be condemned of uncleanness .
text_la: et immunditiæ condemnabitur.
text_pt: E o sacerdote o examinará, e eis que, se a pústula na pele se tem estendido, o sacerdote o declarará por imundo; é lepra.
text_el: καὶ ὄψεται αὐτὸν ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ ἰδοὺ μετέπεσεν ἡ σημασία ἐν τῷ δέρματι καὶ μιανεῖ αὐτὸν ὁ ἱερεύς λέπρα ἐστίν

text_en: If the stroke of the leprosy be in a man , he shall be brought to the priest :
text_la: Plaga lepræ si fuerit in homine, adducetur ad sacerdotem,
text_pt: Quando no homem houver praga de lepra, será levado ao sacerdote,
text_el: καὶ ἁφὴ λέπρας ἐὰν γένηται ἐν ἀνθρώπῳ καὶ ἥξει πρὸς τὸν ἱερέα

text_en: And he shall view him. And when there shall be a white colour in the skin, and it shall have changed the look of the hair, and the living flesh itself shall appear:
text_la: et videbit eum. Cumque color albus in cute fuerit, et capillorum mutaverit aspectum, ipsa quoque caro viva apparuerit:
text_pt: E o sacerdote o examinará, e eis que, se há inchação branca na pele, a qual tornou o pêlo em branco, e houver carne viva na inchação,
text_el: καὶ ὄψεται ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ ἰδοὺ οὐλὴ λευκὴ ἐν τῷ δέρματι καὶ αὕτη μετέβαλεν τρίχα λευκήν καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ ὑγιοῦς τῆς σαρκὸς τῆς ζώσης ἐν τῇ οὐλῇ

text_en: It shall be judged an inveterate leprosy , and grown into the skin. The priest therefore shall declare him unclean : and shall not shut him up, because he is evidently unclean .
text_la: lepra vetustissima judicabitur, atque inolita cuti. Contaminabit itaque eum sacerdos, et non recludet, quia perspicuæ immunditiæ est.
text_pt: Lepra inveterada é na pele da sua carne; portanto, o sacerdote o declarará por imundo; não o encerrará, porque imundo é.
text_el: λέπρα παλαιουμένη ἐστίν ἐν τῷ δέρματι τοῦ χρωτός ἐστιν καὶ μιανεῖ αὐτὸν ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ ἀφοριεῖ αὐτόν ὅτι ἀκάθαρτός ἐστιν

text_en: But if the leprosy spring out running about in the skin, and cover all the skin from the head to the feet, whatsoever falls under the sight of the eyes:
text_la: Sin autem effloruerit discurrens lepra in cute, et operuerit omnem cutem a capite usque ad pedes, quidquid sub aspectum oculorum cadit,
text_pt: E, se a lepra se espalhar de todo na pele, e a lepra cobrir toda a pele do que tem a praga, desde a sua cabeça até aos seus pés, quanto podem ver os olhos do sacerdote,
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἐξανθοῦσα ἐξανθήσῃ ἡ λέπρα ἐν τῷ δέρματι καὶ καλύψῃ ἡ λέπρα πᾶν τὸ δέρμα τῆς ἁφῆς ἀπὸ κεφαλῆς ἕως ποδῶν καθ' ὅλην τὴν ὅρασιν τοῦ ἱερέως

text_en: The priest shall view him, and shall judge that the leprosy which he has is very clean: because it is all turned into whiteness, and therefore the man shall be clean.
text_la: considerabit eum sacerdos, et teneri lepra mundissima judicabit : eo quod omnis in candorem versa sit, et idcirco homo mundus erit.
text_pt: Então o sacerdote examinará, e eis que, se a lepra tem coberto toda a sua carne, então declarará o que tem a praga por limpo; todo se tornou branco; limpo está.
text_el: καὶ ὄψεται ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐκάλυψεν ἡ λέπρα πᾶν τὸ δέρμα τοῦ χρωτός καὶ καθαριεῖ αὐτὸν ὁ ἱερεὺς τὴν ἁφήν ὅτι πᾶν μετέβαλεν λευκόν καθαρόν ἐστιν

text_en: But when the live flesh shall appear in him:
text_la: Quando vero caro vivens in eo apparuerit,
text_pt: Mas no dia em que aparecer nela carne viva será imundo.
text_el: καὶ ᾗ ἂν ἡμέρᾳ ὀφθῇ ἐν αὐτῷ χρὼς ζῶν μιανθήσεται

text_en: Then by the judgment of the priest he shall be defiled, and shall be reckoned among the unclean . For live flesh, if it be spotted with leprosy , is unclean .
text_la: tunc sacerdotis judicio polluetur, et inter immundos reputabitur : caro enim viva, si lepra aspergitur, immunda est.
text_pt: Vendo, pois, o sacerdote a carne viva, declará-lo-á por imundo; a carne é imunda; é lepra.
text_el: καὶ ὄψεται ὁ ἱερεὺς τὸν χρῶτα τὸν ὑγιῆ καὶ μιανεῖ αὐτὸν ὁ χρὼς ὁ ὑγιής ὅτι ἀκάθαρτός ἐστιν λέπρα ἐστίν

text_en: And if again it be turned into whiteness, and cover all the man :
text_la: Quod si rursum versa fuerit in alborem, et totum hominem operuerit,
text_pt: Ou, tornando a carne viva, e mudando-se em branca, então virá ao sacerdote,
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἀποκαταστῇ ὁ χρὼς ὁ ὑγιὴς καὶ μεταβάλῃ λευκή καὶ ἐλεύσεται πρὸς τὸν ἱερέα

text_en: The priest shall view him, and shall judge him to be clean.
text_la: considerabit eum sacerdos, et mundum esse decernet.
text_pt: E este o examinará, e eis que, se a praga se tornou branca, então o sacerdote declarará limpo o que tem a praga; limpo está.
text_el: καὶ ὄψεται ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ ἰδοὺ μετέβαλεν ἡ ἁφὴ εἰς τὸ λευκόν καὶ καθαριεῖ ὁ ἱερεὺς τὴν ἁφήν καθαρός ἐστιν

text_en: When also there has been an ulcer in the flesh and the skin, and it has been healed:
text_la: Caro autem et cutis in qua ulcus natum est, et sanatum,
text_pt: Se também a carne, em cuja pele houver alguma úlcera, sarar,
text_el: καὶ σὰρξ ἐὰν γένηται ἐν τῷ δέρματι αὐτοῦ ἕλκος καὶ ὑγιασθῇ

text_en: And in the place of the ulcer, there appears a white scar, or somewhat red, the man shall be brought to the priest .
text_la: et in loco ulceris cicatrix alba apparuerit, sive subrufa, adducetur homo ad sacerdotem.
text_pt: E, em lugar da pústula, vier inchação branca ou mancha lustrosa, tirando a vermelho, mostrar-se-á então ao sacerdote.
text_el: καὶ γένηται ἐν τῷ τόπῳ τοῦ ἕλκους οὐλὴ λευκὴ ἢ τηλαυγὴς λευκαίνουσα ἢ πυρρίζουσα καὶ ὀφθήσεται τῷ ἱερεῖ

text_en: And when he shall see the place of the leprosy lower than the other flesh, and the hair turned white: he shall declare him unclean , for the plague of leprosy is broken out in the ulcer.
text_la: Qui cum viderit locum lepræ humiliorem carne reliqua, et pilos versos in candorem, contaminabit eum : plaga enim lepræ orta est in ulcere.
text_pt: E o sacerdote examinará, e eis que, se ela parece mais funda do que a pele, e o seu pêlo se tornou branco, o sacerdote o declarará por imundo; é praga da lepra que brotou da pústula.
text_el: καὶ ὄψεται ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ ἰδοὺ ἡ ὄψις ταπεινοτέρα τοῦ δέρματος καὶ ἡ θρὶξ αὐτῆς μετέβαλεν εἰς λευκήν καὶ μιανεῖ αὐτὸν ὁ ἱερεύς λέπρα ἐστίν ἐν τῷ ἕλκει ἐξήνθησεν

text_en: But if the hair be of the former colour, and the scar somewhat obscure, and be not lower than the flesh that is near it: he shall shut him up seven days.
text_la: Quod si pilus coloris est pristini, et cicatrix subobscura, et vicina carne non est humilior, recludet eum septem diebus:
text_pt: E o sacerdote, vendo-a, e eis que se nela não houver pêlo branco, nem estiver mais funda do que a pele, mas encolhida, então o sacerdote o encerrará por sete dias.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἴδῃ ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ ἰδοὺ οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν αὐτῷ θρὶξ λευκή καὶ ταπεινὸν μὴ ᾖ ἀπὸ τοῦ δέρματος τοῦ χρωτός καὶ αὐτὴ ᾖ ἀμαυρά ἀφοριεῖ αὐτὸν ὁ ἱερεὺς ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας

text_en: And if it spread, he shall judge him to have the leprosy :
text_la: et si quidem creverit, adjudicabit eum lepræ;
text_pt: Se ela grandemente se estender na pele, o sacerdote o declarará por imundo; praga é.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ διαχέηται ἐν τῷ δέρματι καὶ μιανεῖ αὐτὸν ὁ ἱερεύς ἁφὴ λέπρας ἐστίν ἐν τῷ ἕλκει ἐξήνθησεν

text_en: But if it stay in its place, it is but the scar of an ulcer: and the man shall be clean.
text_la: sin autem steterit in loco suo, ulceris est cicatrix, et homo mundus erit.
text_pt: Mas se a mancha parar no seu lugar, não se estendendo, inflamação da pústula é; o sacerdote, pois, o declarará por limpo.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ κατὰ χώραν μείνῃ τὸ τηλαύγημα καὶ μὴ διαχέηται οὐλὴ τοῦ ἕλκους ἐστίν καὶ καθαριεῖ αὐτὸν ὁ ἱερεύς

text_en: The flesh also and skin that has been burnt, and after it is healed has a white or a red scar:
text_la: Caro autem et cutis, quam ignis exusserit, et sanata albam sive rufam habuerit cicatricem,
text_pt: Ou, quando na pele da carne houver queimadura de fogo, e no que é sarado da queimadura houver mancha lustrosa, tirando a vermelho ou branco,
text_el: καὶ σὰρξ ἐὰν γένηται ἐν τῷ δέρματι αὐτοῦ κατάκαυμα πυρός καὶ γένηται ἐν τῷ δέρματι αὐτοῦ τὸ ὑγιασθὲν τοῦ κατακαύματος αὐγάζον τηλαυγὲς λευκὸν ὑποπυρρίζον ἢ ἔκλευκον

text_en: The priest shall view it, and if he see it turned white, and the place thereof is lower than the other skin: he shall declare him unclean , because the evil of leprosy is broken out in the scar.
text_la: considerabit eam sacerdos : et ecce versa est in alborem, et locus ejus reliqua cute est humilior, contaminabit eum, quia plaga lepræ in cicatrice orta est.
text_pt: E o sacerdote vendo-a, e eis que se o pêlo na mancha se tornou branco e ela parece mais funda do que a pele, lepra é, que floresceu pela queimadura; portanto o sacerdote o declarará por imundo; é praga de lepra.
text_el: καὶ ὄψεται αὐτὸν ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ ἰδοὺ μετέβαλεν θρὶξ λευκὴ εἰς τὸ αὐγάζον καὶ ἡ ὄψις αὐτοῦ ταπεινὴ ἀπὸ τοῦ δέρματος λέπρα ἐστίν ἐν τῷ κατακαύματι ἐξήνθησεν καὶ μιανεῖ αὐτὸν ὁ ἱερεύς ἁφὴ λέπρας ἐστίν

text_en: But if the colour of the hair be not changed, nor the blemish lower than the other flesh, and the appearance of the leprosy be somewhat obscure: he shall shut him up seven days,
text_la: Quod si pilorum color non fuerit immutatus, nec humilior plaga carne reliqua, et ipsa lepræ species fuerit subobscura, recludet eum septem diebus,
text_pt: Mas, se o sacerdote, vendo-a, e eis que, se na mancha não aparecer pêlo branco, nem estiver mais funda do que a pele, mas recolhida, o sacerdote o encerrará por sete dias.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἴδῃ ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ ἰδοὺ οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν τῷ αὐγάζοντι θρὶξ λευκή καὶ ταπεινὸν μὴ ᾖ ἀπὸ τοῦ δέρματος αὐτὸ δὲ ἀμαυρόν καὶ ἀφοριεῖ αὐτὸν ὁ ἱερεὺς ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας

text_en: and on the seventh day he shall view him. If the leprosy be grown farther in the skin, he shall declare him unclean .
text_la: et die septimo contemplabitur : si creverit in cute lepra, contaminabit eum.
text_pt: Depois o sacerdote o examinará ao sétimo dia; se grandemente se houver estendido na pele, o sacerdote o declarará por imundo; é praga de lepra.
text_el: καὶ ὄψεται αὐτὸν ὁ ἱερεὺς τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἑβδόμῃ ἐὰν δὲ διαχύσει διαχέηται ἐν τῷ δέρματι καὶ μιανεῖ αὐτὸν ὁ ἱερεύς ἁφὴ λέπρας ἐστίν ἐν τῷ ἕλκει ἐξήνθησεν

text_en: But if the whiteness stay in its place, and be not very clear, it is the sore of a burning: and therefore he shall be cleansed, because it is only the scar of a burning.
text_la: Sin autem in loco suo candor steterit non satis clarus, plaga combustionis est, et idcirco mundabitur, quia cicatrix est combusturæ.
text_pt: Mas se a mancha parar no seu lugar, e na pele não se estender, mas se recolher, inchação da queimadura é; portanto o sacerdote o declarará por limpo, porque inflamação é da queimadura.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ κατὰ χώραν μείνῃ τὸ αὐγάζον καὶ μὴ διαχυθῇ ἐν τῷ δέρματι αὐτὴ δὲ ᾖ ἀμαυρά ἡ οὐλὴ τοῦ κατακαύματός ἐστιν καὶ καθαριεῖ αὐτὸν ὁ ἱερεύς ὁ γὰρ χαρακτὴρ τοῦ κατακαύματός ἐστιν

text_en: If the leprosy break out in the head or the beard of a man or woman , the priest shall see them,
text_la: Vir, sive mulier, in cujus capite vel barba germinaverit lepra, videbit eos sacerdos.
text_pt: E, quando homem ou mulher tiver chaga na cabeça ou na barba,
text_el: καὶ ἀνδρὶ καὶ γυναικὶ ἐὰν γένηται ἐν αὐτοῖς ἁφὴ λέπρας ἐν τῇ κεφαλῇ ἢ ἐν τῷ πώγωνι

text_en: and if the place be lower than the other flesh, and the hair yellow, and thinner than usual: he shall declare them unclean , because it is the leprosy of the head and the beard ;
text_la: Et si quidem humilior fuerit locus carne reliqua, et capillus flavus, solitoque subtilior, contaminabit eos, quia lepra capitis ac barbæ est.
text_pt: E o sacerdote, examinando a chaga, e eis que, se ela parece mais funda do que a pele, e pêlo amarelo fino há nela, o sacerdote o declarará por imundo; é tinha, é lepra da cabeça ou da barba.
text_el: καὶ ὄψεται ὁ ἱερεὺς τὴν ἁφὴν καὶ ἰδοὺ ἡ ὄψις αὐτῆς ἐγκοιλοτέρα τοῦ δέρματος ἐν αὐτῇ δὲ θρὶξ ξανθίζουσα λεπτή καὶ μιανεῖ αὐτὸν ὁ ἱερεύς θραῦσμά ἐστιν λέπρα τῆς κεφαλῆς ἢ λέπρα τοῦ πώγωνός ἐστιν

text_en: but if he perceive the place of the spot is equal with the flesh that is near it, and the hair black: he shall shut him up seven days,
text_la: Sin autem viderit locum maculæ æqualem vicinæ carni, et capillum nigrum : recludet eum septem diebus,
text_pt: Mas, se o sacerdote, havendo examinado a praga da tinha, e eis que, se ela não parece mais funda do que a pele, e se nela não houver pêlo preto, então o sacerdote encerrará o que tem a praga da tinha por sete dias.
text_el: καὶ ἐὰν ἴδῃ ὁ ἱερεὺς τὴν ἁφὴν τοῦ θραύσματος καὶ ἰδοὺ οὐχ ἡ ὄψις ἐγκοιλοτέρα τοῦ δέρματος καὶ θρὶξ ξανθίζουσα οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν αὐτῇ καὶ ἀφοριεῖ ὁ ἱερεὺς τὴν ἁφὴν τοῦ θραύσματος ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας

text_en: and on the seventh day he shall look upon it. If the spot be not grown, and the hair keep its colour, and the place of the blemish be even with the other flesh:
text_la: et die septimo intuebitur. Si non creverit macula, et capillus sui coloris est, et locus plagæ carni reliquæ æqualis:
text_pt: E o sacerdote examinará a praga ao sétimo dia; e eis que, se a tinha não se tiver estendido, e nela não houver pêlo amarelo, nem a tinha parecer mais funda do que a pele,
text_el: καὶ ὄψεται ὁ ἱερεὺς τὴν ἁφὴν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἑβδόμῃ καὶ ἰδοὺ οὐ διεχύθη τὸ θραῦσμα καὶ θρὶξ ξανθίζουσα οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν αὐτῇ καὶ ἡ ὄψις τοῦ θραύσματος οὐκ ἔστιν κοίλη ἀπὸ τοῦ δέρματος

text_en: The man shall be shaven all but the place of the spot: and he shall be shut up other seven days.
text_la: radetur homo absque loco maculæ, et includetur septem diebus aliis.
text_pt: Então se rapará; mas não rapará a tinha; e o sacerdote segunda vez encerrará o que tem a tinha por sete dias.
text_el: καὶ ξυρηθήσεται τὸ δέρμα τὸ δὲ θραῦσμα οὐ ξυρηθήσεται καὶ ἀφοριεῖ ὁ ἱερεὺς τὸ θραῦσμα ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας τὸ δεύτερον

text_en: If on the seventh day the evil seem to have stayed in its place, and not lower than the other flesh, he shall cleanse him: and his clothes being washed he shall be clean .
text_la: Si die septimo visa fuerit stetisse plaga in loco suo, nec humilior carne reliqua, mundabit eum : lotisque vestibus suis, mundus erit.
text_pt: Depois o sacerdote examinará a tinha ao sétimo dia; e eis que, se a tinha não se houver estendido na pele, e ela não parecer mais funda do que a pele, o sacerdote o declarará por limpo, e lavará as suas vestes, e será limpo.
text_el: καὶ ὄψεται ὁ ἱερεὺς τὸ θραῦσμα τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἑβδόμῃ καὶ ἰδοὺ οὐ διεχύθη τὸ θραῦσμα ἐν τῷ δέρματι μετὰ τὸ ξυρηθῆναι αὐτόν καὶ ἡ ὄψις τοῦ θραύσματος οὐκ ἔστιν κοίλη ἀπὸ τοῦ δέρματος καὶ καθαριεῖ αὐτὸν ὁ ἱερεύς καὶ πλυνάμενος τὰ ἱμάτια καθαρὸς ἔσται

text_en: But if after his cleansing the spot spread again in the skin:
text_la: Sin autem post emundationem rursus creverit macula in cute,
text_pt: Mas, se a tinha, depois da sua purificação, se houver estendido grandemente na pele,
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ διαχύσει διαχέηται τὸ θραῦσμα ἐν τῷ δέρματι μετὰ τὸ καθαρισθῆναι αὐτόν

text_en: He shall seek no more whether the hair be turned yellow, because he is evidently unclean .
text_la: non quæret amplius utrum capillus in flavum colorem sit immutatus, quia aperte immundus est.
text_pt: Então o sacerdote o examinará, e eis que, se a tinha se tem estendido na pele, o sacerdote não buscará pêlo amarelo; imundo está.
text_el: καὶ ὄψεται ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ ἰδοὺ διακέχυται τὸ θραῦσμα ἐν τῷ δέρματι οὐκ ἐπισκέψεται ὁ ἱερεὺς περὶ τῆς τριχὸς τῆς ξανθῆς ὅτι ἀκάθαρτός ἐστιν

text_en: But if the spot be stayed, and the hair be black, let him know that the man is healed: and let him confidently pronounce him clean .
text_la: Porro si steterit macula, et capilli nigri fuerint, noverit hominem sanatum esse, et confidenter eum pronuntiet mundum.
text_pt: Mas, se a tinha ao seu ver parou, e pêlo preto nela cresceu, a tinha está sã, limpo está; portanto o sacerdote o declarará por limpo.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἐνώπιον μείνῃ τὸ θραῦσμα ἐπὶ χώρας καὶ θρὶξ μέλαινα ἀνατείλῃ ἐν αὐτῷ ὑγίακεν τὸ θραῦσμα καθαρός ἐστιν καὶ καθαριεῖ αὐτὸν ὁ ἱερεύς

text_en: If a whiteness appear in the skin of a man or a woman ,
text_la: Vir, sive mulier, in cujus cute candor apparuerit,
text_pt: E, quando homem ou mulher tiver manchas lustrosas brancas na pele da sua carne,
text_el: καὶ ἀνδρὶ ἢ γυναικὶ ἐὰν γένηται ἐν δέρματι τῆς σαρκὸς αὐτοῦ αὐγάσματα αὐγάζοντα λευκαθίζοντα

text_en: the priest shall view them. If he find that a darkish whiteness shines in the skin, let him know that it is not the leprosy , but a white blemish, and that the man is clean .
text_la: intuebitur eos sacerdos. Si deprehenderit subobscurum alborem lucere in cute, sciat non esse lepram, sed maculam coloris candidi, et hominem mundum.
text_pt: Então o sacerdote olhará, e eis que, se na pele da sua carne aparecem manchas lustrosas escurecidas, é impigem que floresceu na pele, limpo está.
text_el: καὶ ὄψεται ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐν δέρματι τῆς σαρκὸς αὐτοῦ αὐγάσματα αὐγάζοντα λευκαθίζοντα ἀλφός ἐστιν καθαρός ἐστιν ἐξανθεῖ ἐν τῷ δέρματι τῆς σαρκὸς αὐτοῦ καθαρός ἐστιν

text_en: The man whose hair falls off from his head, he is bald and clean :
text_la: Vir, de cujus capite capilli fluunt, calvus et mundus est:
text_pt: E, quando os cabelos do homem caírem da cabeça, calvo é, mas limpo está.
text_el: ἐὰν δέ τινι μαδήσῃ ἡ κεφαλὴ αὐτοῦ φαλακρός ἐστιν καθαρός ἐστιν

text_en: And if the hair fall from his forehead, he is bald before and clean .
text_la: et si a fronte ceciderint pili, recalvaster et mundus est.
text_pt: E, se lhe caírem os cabelos na frente da cabeça, meio calvo é; mas limpo está.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ κατὰ πρόσωπον μαδήσῃ ἡ κεφαλὴ αὐτοῦ ἀναφάλαντός ἐστιν καθαρός ἐστιν

text_en: But if in the bald head or in the bald forehead there be risen a white or reddish colour:
text_la: Sin autem in calvitio sive in recalvatione albus vel rufus color fuerit exortus,
text_pt: Porém, se na calva, ou na meia calva, houver praga branca avermelhada, é lepra, florescendo na sua calva ou na sua meia calva.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ γένηται ἐν τῷ φαλακρώματι αὐτοῦ ἢ ἐν τῷ ἀναφαλαντώματι αὐτοῦ ἁφὴ λευκὴ ἢ πυρρίζουσα λέπρα ἐστὶν ἐν τῷ φαλακρώματι αὐτοῦ ἢ ἐν τῷ ἀναφαλαντώματι αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the priest perceive this, he shall condemn him undoubtedly of leprosy which is risen in the bald part.
text_la: et hoc sacerdos viderit, condemnabit eum haud dubiæ lepræ, quæ orta est in calvitio.
text_pt: Havendo, pois, o sacerdote examinado, e eis que, se a inchação da praga, na sua calva ou meia calva, está branca, tirando a vermelho, como parece a lepra na pele da carne,
text_el: καὶ ὄψεται αὐτὸν ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ ἰδοὺ ἡ ὄψις τῆς ἁφῆς λευκὴ πυρρίζουσα ἐν τῷ φαλακρώματι αὐτοῦ ἢ ἐν τῷ ἀναφαλαντώματι αὐτοῦ ὡς εἶδος λέπρας ἐν δέρματι τῆς σαρκὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: Now whosoever shall be defiled with the leprosy , and is separated by the judgment of the priest :
text_la: Quicumque ergo maculatus fuerit lepra, et separatus est ad arbitrium sacerdotis,
text_pt: Leproso é aquele homem, imundo está; o sacerdote o declarará totalmente por imundo, na sua cabeça tem a praga.
text_el: ἄνθρωπος λεπρός ἐστιν μιάνσει μιανεῖ αὐτὸν ὁ ἱερεύς ἐν τῇ κεφαλῇ αὐτοῦ ἡ ἁφὴ αὐτοῦ

text_en: Shall have his clothes hanging loose, his head bare, his mouth covered with a cloth: and he shall cry out that he is defiled and unclean .
text_la: habebit vestimenta dissuta, caput nudum, os veste contectum, contaminatum ac sordidum se clamabit.
text_pt: Também as vestes do leproso, em quem está a praga, serão rasgadas, e a sua cabeça será descoberta, e cobrirá o lábio superior, e clamará: Imundo, imundo.
text_el: καὶ ὁ λεπρός ἐν ᾧ ἐστιν ἡ ἁφή τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ ἔστω παραλελυμένα καὶ ἡ κεφαλὴ αὐτοῦ ἀκατακάλυπτος καὶ περὶ τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ περιβαλέσθω καὶ ἀκάθαρτος κεκλήσεται

text_en: All the time that he is a leper and unclean he shall dwell alone without the camp.
text_la: Omni tempore quo leprosus est et immundus, solus habitabit extra castra.
text_pt: Todos os dias em que a praga houver nele, será imundo; imundo está, habitará só; a sua habitação será fora do arraial.
text_el: πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας ὅσας ἂν ᾖ ἐπ' αὐτοῦ ἡ ἁφή ἀκάθαρτος ὢν ἀκάθαρτος ἔσται κεχωρισμένος καθήσεται ἔξω τῆς παρεμβολῆς ἔσται αὐτοῦ ἡ διατριβή

text_en: A woollen or linen garment that shall have the leprosy
text_la: Vestis lanea sive linea, quæ lepram habuerit,
text_pt: Quando também em alguma roupa houver praga de lepra, em roupa de lã, ou em roupa de linho,
text_el: καὶ ἱματίῳ ἐὰν γένηται ἐν αὐτῷ ἁφὴ λέπρας ἐν ἱματίῳ ἐρεῷ ἢ ἐν ἱματίῳ στιππυίνῳ

text_en: in the warp, and the woof: or skin, or whatsoever is made of a skin:
text_la: in stamine atque subtegmine, aut certe pellis, vel quidquid ex pelle confectum est,
text_pt: Ou no fio urdido, ou no fio tecido, seja de linho, ou seja de lã, ou em pele, ou em qualquer obra de peles,
text_el: ἢ ἐν στήμονι ἢ ἐν κρόκῃ ἢ ἐν τοῖς λινοῖς ἢ ἐν τοῖς ἐρεοῖς ἢ ἐν δέρματι ἢ ἐν παντὶ ἐργασίμῳ δέρματι

text_en: If it be infected with a white or red spot, it shall be accounted the leprosy , and shall be shown to the priest .
text_la: si alba vel rufa macula fuerit infecta, lepra reputabitur, ostendeturque sacerdoti:
text_pt: E a praga na roupa, ou na pele, ou no fio urdido, ou no fio tecido, ou em qualquer coisa de peles aparecer verde ou vermelha, praga de lepra é, por isso se mostrará ao sacerdote,
text_el: καὶ γένηται ἡ ἁφὴ χλωρίζουσα ἢ πυρρίζουσα ἐν τῷ δέρματι ἢ ἐν τῷ ἱματίῳ ἢ ἐν τῷ στήμονι ἢ ἐν τῇ κρόκῃ ἢ ἐν παντὶ σκεύει ἐργασίμῳ δέρματος ἁφὴ λέπρας ἐστίν καὶ δείξει τῷ ἱερεῖ

text_en: And he shall look upon it and shall shut it up seven days.
text_la: qui consideratam recludet septem diebus:
text_pt: E o sacerdote examinará a praga, e encerrará aquilo que tem a praga por sete dias.
text_el: καὶ ὄψεται ὁ ἱερεὺς τὴν ἁφήν καὶ ἀφοριεῖ ὁ ἱερεὺς τὴν ἁφὴν ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας

text_en: And on the seventh day when he looks on it again, if he find that it is grown, it is a fixed leprosy . He shall judge the garment unclean , and everything wherein it shall be found.
text_la: et die septimo rursus aspiciens, si deprehenderit crevisse, lepra perseverans est : pollutum judicabit vestimentum, et omne in quo fuerit inventa:
text_pt: Então examinará a praga ao sétimo dia; se a praga se houver estendido na roupa, ou no fio urdido, ou no fio tecido ou na pele, para qualquer obra que for feita da pele, lepra roedora é, imunda está;
text_el: καὶ ὄψεται ὁ ἱερεὺς τὴν ἁφὴν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἑβδόμῃ ἐὰν δὲ διαχέηται ἡ ἁφὴ ἐν τῷ ἱματίῳ ἢ ἐν τῷ στήμονι ἢ ἐν τῇ κρόκῃ ἢ ἐν τῷ δέρματι κατὰ πάντα ὅσα ἂν ποιηθῇ δέρματα ἐν τῇ ἐργασίᾳ λέπρα ἔμμονός ἐστιν ἡ ἁφή ἀκάθαρτός ἐστιν

text_en: And therefore it shall be burnt with fire.
text_la: et idcirco comburetur flammis.
text_pt: Por isso se queimará aquela roupa, ou fio urdido, ou fio tecido de lã, ou de linho, ou de qualquer obra de peles, em que houver a praga, porque lepra roedora é; com fogo se queimará.
text_el: κατακαύσει τὸ ἱμάτιον ἢ τὸν στήμονα ἢ τὴν κρόκην ἐν τοῖς ἐρεοῖς ἢ ἐν τοῖς λινοῖς ἢ ἐν παντὶ σκεύει δερματίνῳ ἐν ᾧ ἐὰν ᾖ ἐν αὐτῷ ἡ ἁφή ὅτι λέπρα ἔμμονός ἐστιν ἐν πυρὶ κατακαυθήσεται

text_en: But if he see that it is not grown,
text_la: Quod si eam viderit non crevisse,
text_pt: Mas, o sacerdote, vendo, e eis que, se a praga não se estendeu na roupa, ou no fio urdido, ou no tecido, ou em qualquer obra de peles,
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἴδῃ ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ μὴ διαχέηται ἡ ἁφὴ ἐν τῷ ἱματίῳ ἢ ἐν τῷ στήμονι ἢ ἐν τῇ κρόκῃ ἢ ἐν παντὶ σκεύει δερματίνῳ

text_en: he shall give orders, and they shall wash that part wherein the leprosy is: and he shall shut it up other seven days.
text_la: præcipiet, et lavabunt id in quo lepra est, recludetque illud septem diebus aliis.
text_pt: Então o sacerdote ordenará que se lave aquilo no qual havia a praga, e o encerrará segunda vez por sete dias;
text_el: καὶ συντάξει ὁ ἱερεύς καὶ πλυνεῖ ἐφ' οὗ ἐὰν ᾖ ἐπ' αὐτοῦ ἡ ἁφή καὶ ἀφοριεῖ ὁ ἱερεὺς τὴν ἁφὴν ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας τὸ δεύτερον

text_en: And when he shall see that the former colour is not returned, nor yet the leprosy spread, he shall judge it unclean : and shall burn it with fire, for the leprosy has taken hold of the outside of the garment, or through the whole.
text_la: Et cum viderit faciem quidem pristinam non reversam, nec tamen crevisse lepram, immundum judicabit, et igne comburet, eo quod infusa sit in superficie vestimenti, vel per totum, lepra.
text_pt: E o sacerdote, examinando a praga, depois que for lavada, e eis que se ela não mudou o seu aspecto, nem se estendeu, imundo está, com fogo o queimarás; praga penetrante é, seja por dentro ou por fora.
text_el: καὶ ὄψεται ὁ ἱερεὺς μετὰ τὸ πλυθῆναι αὐτὸ τὴν ἁφήν καὶ ἥδε μὴ μετέβαλεν τὴν ὄψιν ἡ ἁφή καὶ ἡ ἁφὴ οὐ διαχεῖται ἀκάθαρτόν ἐστιν ἐν πυρὶ κατακαυθήσεται ἐστήρισται ἐν τῷ ἱματίῳ ἢ ἐν τῷ στήμονι ἢ ἐν τῇ κρόκῃ

text_en: But if the place of the leprosy be somewhat dark, after the garment is washed, he shall tear it off, and divide it from that which is sound.
text_la: Sin autem obscurior fuerit locus lepræ, postquam vestis est lota, abrumpet eum, et a solido dividet.
text_pt: Mas se o sacerdote verificar que a praga se tem recolhido, depois de lavada, então a rasgará da roupa, ou da pele ou do fio urdido ou tecido;
text_el: καὶ ἐὰν ἴδῃ ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ ᾖ ἀμαυρὰ ἡ ἁφὴ μετὰ τὸ πλυθῆναι αὐτό ἀπορρήξει αὐτὸ ἀπὸ τοῦ ἱματίου ἢ ἀπὸ τοῦ δέρματος ἢ ἀπὸ τοῦ στήμονος ἢ ἀπὸ τῆς κρόκης

text_en: And if after this there appear in those places that before were without spot, a flying and wandering leprosy : it must be burnt with fire.
text_la: Quod si ultra apparuerit in his locis, quæ prius immaculata erant, lepra volatilis et vaga, debet igne comburi.
text_pt: E, se ainda aparecer na roupa, ou no fio urdido ou tecido ou em qualquer coisa de peles, lepra brotante é; com fogo queimarás aquilo em que há a praga;
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ὀφθῇ ἔτι ἐν τῷ ἱματίῳ ἢ ἐν τῷ στήμονι ἢ ἐν τῇ κρόκῃ ἢ ἐν παντὶ σκεύει δερματίνῳ λέπρα ἐξανθοῦσά ἐστιν ἐν πυρὶ κατακαυθήσεται ἐν ᾧ ἐστὶν ἡ ἁφή

text_en: If it cease, he shall wash with water the parts that are pure, the second time: and they shall be clean.
text_la: Si cessaverit, lavabit aqua ea, quæ pura sunt, secundo, et munda erunt.
text_pt: Mas a roupa ou fio urdido ou tecido ou qualquer coisa de peles, que lavares, e de que a praga se retirar, se lavará segunda vez, e será limpa.
text_el: καὶ τὸ ἱμάτιον ἢ ὁ στήμων ἢ ἡ κρόκη ἢ πᾶν σκεῦος δερμάτινον ὃ πλυθήσεται καὶ ἀποστήσεται ἀπ' αὐτοῦ ἡ ἁφή καὶ πλυθήσεται τὸ δεύτερον καὶ καθαρὸν ἔσται

text_en: This is the law touching the leprosy of any woollen or linen garment, either in the warp or woof, or anything of skins: how it ought to be cleaned, or pronounced unclean .
text_la: Ista est lex lepræ vestimenti lanei et linei, staminis, atque subtegminis, omnisque supellectilis pelliceæ, quomodo mundari debeat, vel contaminari.
text_pt: Esta é a lei da praga da lepra na roupa de lã, ou de linho, ou do fio urdido, ou tecido, ou de qualquer coisa de peles, para declará-la limpa, ou para declará-la imunda.
text_el: οὗτος ὁ νόμος ἁφῆς λέπρας ἱματίου ἐρεοῦ ἢ στιππυίνου ἢ στήμονος ἢ κρόκης ἢ παντὸς σκεύους δερματίνου εἰς τὸ καθαρίσαι αὐτὸ ἢ μιᾶναι αὐτό

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses , saying:
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:
text_pt: Depois falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: This is the rite of a leper , when he is to be cleansed. He shall be brought to the priest :
text_la: Hic est ritus leprosi, quando mundandus est. Adducetur ad sacerdotem:
text_pt: Esta será a lei do leproso no dia da sua purificação: será levado ao sacerdote,
text_el: οὗτος ὁ νόμος τοῦ λεπροῦ ᾗ ἂν ἡμέρᾳ καθαρισθῇ καὶ προσαχθήσεται πρὸς τὸν ἱερέα

text_en: Who going out of the camp, when he shall find that the leprosy is cleansed,
text_la: qui egressus de castris, cum invenerit lepram esse mundatam,
text_pt: E o sacerdote sairá fora do arraial, e o examinará, e eis que, se a praga da lepra do leproso for sarada,
text_el: καὶ ἐξελεύσεται ὁ ἱερεὺς ἔξω τῆς παρεμβολῆς καὶ ὄψεται ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ ἰδοὺ ἰᾶται ἡ ἁφὴ τῆς λέπρας ἀπὸ τοῦ λεπροῦ

text_en: shall command him that is to be purified, to offer for himself two living sparrows, which it is lawful to eat, and cedar wood , and scarlet, and hyssop .
text_la: præcipiet ei, qui purificatur, ut offerat duos passeres vivos pro se, quibus vesci licitum est, et lignum cedrinum, vermiculumque et hyssopum.
text_pt: Então o sacerdote ordenará que por aquele que se houver de purificar se tomem duas aves vivas e limpas, e pau de cedro, e carmesim, e hissopo.
text_el: καὶ προστάξει ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ λήμψονται τῷ κεκαθαρισμένῳ δύο ὀρνίθια ζῶντα καθαρὰ καὶ ξύλον κέδρινον καὶ κεκλωσμένον κόκκινον καὶ ὕσσωπον

text_en: And he shall command one of the sparrows to be immolated in an earthen vessel over living waters.
text_la: Et unum ex passeribus immolari jubebit in vase fictili super aquas viventes:
text_pt: Mandará também o sacerdote que se degole uma ave num vaso de barro sobre águas vivas,
text_el: καὶ προστάξει ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ σφάξουσιν τὸ ὀρνίθιον τὸ ἓν εἰς ἀγγεῖον ὀστράκινον ἐφ' ὕδατι ζῶντι

text_en: But the other that is alive, he shall dip, with the cedar wood , and the scarlet and the hyssop , in the blood of the sparrow that is immolated:
text_la: alium autem vivum cum ligno cedrino, et cocco et hyssopo, tinget in sanguine passeris immolati,
text_pt: E tomará a ave viva, e o pau de cedro, e o carmesim, e o hissopo, e os molhará, com a ave viva, no sangue da ave que foi degolada sobre as águas correntes.
text_el: καὶ τὸ ὀρνίθιον τὸ ζῶν λήμψεται αὐτὸ καὶ τὸ ξύλον τὸ κέδρινον καὶ τὸ κλωστὸν κόκκινον καὶ τὸν ὕσσωπον καὶ βάψει αὐτὰ καὶ τὸ ὀρνίθιον τὸ ζῶν εἰς τὸ αἷμα τοῦ ὀρνιθίου τοῦ σφαγέντος ἐφ' ὕδατι ζῶντι

text_en: Wherewith he shall sprinkle him that is to be cleansed seven times, that he may be rightly purified. And he shall let go the living sparrow, that it may fly into the field.
text_la: quo asperget illum, qui mundandus est, septies, ut jure purgetur : et dimittet passerem vivum, ut in agrum avolet.
text_pt: E sobre aquele que há de purificar-se da lepra espargirá sete vezes; então o declarará por limpo, e soltará a ave viva sobre a face do campo.
text_el: καὶ περιρρανεῖ ἐπὶ τὸν καθαρισθέντα ἀπὸ τῆς λέπρας ἑπτάκις καὶ καθαρὸς ἔσται καὶ ἐξαποστελεῖ τὸ ὀρνίθιον τὸ ζῶν εἰς τὸ πεδίον

text_en: And when the man has washed his clothes, he shall shave all the hair of his body, and shall be washed with water: and being purified he shall enter into the camp, yet so that he tarry without his own tent seven days.
text_la: Cumque laverit homo vestimenta sua, radet omnes pilos corporis, et lavabitur aqua : purificatusque ingredietur castra, ita dumtaxat ut maneat extra tabernaculum suum septem diebus,
text_pt: E aquele que tem de purificar-se lavará as suas vestes, e rapará todo o seu pêlo, e se lavará com água; assim será limpo; e depois entrará no arraial, porém, ficará fora da sua tenda por sete dias;
text_el: καὶ πλυνεῖ ὁ καθαρισθεὶς τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ καὶ ξυρηθήσεται αὐτοῦ πᾶσαν τὴν τρίχα καὶ λούσεται ἐν ὕδατι καὶ καθαρὸς ἔσται καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα εἰσελεύσεται εἰς τὴν παρεμβολὴν καὶ διατρίψει ἔξω τοῦ οἴκου αὐτοῦ ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας

text_en: And on the seventh day he shall shave the hair of his head, and his beard and his eyebrows, and the hair of all his body. And having washed again his clothes, and his body,
text_la: et die septimo radet capillos capitis, barbamque et supercilia, ac totius corporis pilos. Et lotis rursum vestibus et corpore,
text_pt: E será que ao sétimo dia rapará todo o seu pêlo, a sua cabeça, e a sua barba, e as sobrancelhas; sim, rapará todo o pêlo, e lavará as suas vestes, e lavará a sua carne com água, e será limpo,
text_el: καὶ ἔσται τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἑβδόμῃ ξυρηθήσεται πᾶσαν τὴν τρίχα αὐτοῦ τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ τὸν πώγωνα καὶ τὰς ὀφρύας καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν τρίχα αὐτοῦ ξυρηθήσεται καὶ πλυνεῖ τὰ ἱμάτια καὶ λούσεται τὸ σῶμα αὐτοῦ ὕδατι καὶ καθαρὸς ἔσται

text_en: on the eighth day, he shall take two lambs without blemish, and an ewe of a year old without blemish, and three tenths of flour tempered with oil for a sacrifice , and a sextary of oil apart.
text_la: die octavo assumet duos agnos immaculatos, et ovem anniculam absque macula, et tres decimas similæ in sacrificium, quæ conspersa sit oleo, et seorsum olei sextarium.
text_pt: E ao oitavo dia tomará dois cordeiros sem defeito, e uma cordeira sem defeito, de um ano, e três dízimas de flor de farinha para oferta de alimentos, amassada com azeite, e um logue de azeite;
text_el: καὶ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ὀγδόῃ λήμψεται δύο ἀμνοὺς ἐνιαυσίους ἀμώμους καὶ πρόβατον ἐνιαύσιον ἄμωμον καὶ τρία δέκατα σεμιδάλεως εἰς θυσίαν πεφυραμένης ἐν ἐλαίῳ καὶ κοτύλην ἐλαίου μίαν

text_en: And when the priest that purifies the man , has presented him, and all these things before the Lord , at the door of the tabernacle of the testimony :
text_la: Cumque sacerdos purificans hominem, statuerit eum, et hæc omnia coram Domino in ostio tabernaculi testimonii,
text_pt: E o sacerdote que faz a purificação apresentará o homem que houver de purificar-se, com aquelas coisas, perante o Senhor, à porta da tenda da congregação.
text_el: καὶ στήσει ὁ ἱερεὺς ὁ καθαρίζων τὸν ἄνθρωπον τὸν καθαριζόμενον καὶ ταῦτα ἔναντι κυρίου ἐπὶ τὴν θύραν τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου

text_en: He shall take a lamb, and offer it for a trespass offering with the sextary of oil. And having offered all before the Lord ,
text_la: tollet agnum et offeret eum pro delicto, oleique sextarium : et oblatis ante Dominum omnibus,
text_pt: E o sacerdote tomará um dos cordeiros, e o oferecerá por expiação da culpa, e o logue de azeite; e os oferecerá por oferta movida perante o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ λήμψεται ὁ ἱερεὺς τὸν ἀμνὸν τὸν ἕνα καὶ προσάξει αὐτὸν τῆς πλημμελείας καὶ τὴν κοτύλην τοῦ ἐλαίου καὶ ἀφοριεῖ αὐτὸ ἀφόρισμα ἔναντι κυρίου

text_en: he shall immolate the lamb, where the victim for sin is wont to be immolated, and the holocaust , that is, in the holy place. For as that which is for sin , so also the victim for a trespass offering pertains to the priest : it is holy of holies.
text_la: immolabit agnum, ubi solet immolari hostia pro peccato, et holocaustum, id est, in loco sancto. Sicut enim pro peccato, ita et pro delicto ad sacerdotem pertinet hostia : Sancta sanctorum est.
text_pt: Então degolará o cordeiro no lugar em que se degola a oferta da expiação do pecado e o holocausto, no lugar santo; porque quer a oferta da expiação da culpa como a da expiação do pecado é para o sacerdote; coisa santíssima é.
text_el: καὶ σφάξουσιν τὸν ἀμνὸν ἐν τόπῳ οὗ σφάζουσιν τὰ ὁλοκαυτώματα καὶ τὰ περὶ ἁμαρτίας ἐν τόπῳ ἁγίῳ ἔστιν γὰρ τὸ περὶ ἁμαρτίας ὥσπερ τὸ τῆς πλημμελείας ἔστιν τῷ ἱερεῖ ἅγια ἁγίων ἐστίν

text_en: And the priest taking of the blood of the victim that was immolated for trespass, shall put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand and the great toe of his right foot.
text_la: Assumensque sacerdos de sanguine hostiæ, quæ immolata est pro delicto, ponet super extremum auriculæ dextræ ejus qui mundatur, et super pollices manus dextræ et pedis:
text_pt: E o sacerdote tomará do sangue da expiação da culpa, e o porá sobre a ponta da orelha direita daquele que tem de purificar-se e sobre o dedo polegar da sua mão direita, e no dedo polegar do seu pé direito.
text_el: καὶ λήμψεται ὁ ἱερεὺς ἀπὸ τοῦ αἵματος τοῦ τῆς πλημμελείας καὶ ἐπιθήσει ὁ ἱερεὺς ἐπὶ τὸν λοβὸν τοῦ ὠτὸς τοῦ καθαριζομένου τοῦ δεξιοῦ καὶ ἐπὶ τὸ ἄκρον τῆς χειρὸς τῆς δεξιᾶς καὶ ἐπὶ τὸ ἄκρον τοῦ ποδὸς τοῦ δεξιοῦ

text_en: And he shall pour of the sextary of oil into his own left hand,
text_la: et de olei sextario mittet in manum suam sinistram,
text_pt: Também o sacerdote tomará do logue de azeite, e o derramará na palma da sua própria mão esquerda.
text_el: καὶ λαβὼν ὁ ἱερεὺς ἀπὸ τῆς κοτύλης τοῦ ἐλαίου ἐπιχεεῖ ἐπὶ τὴν χεῖρα τοῦ ἱερέως τὴν ἀριστερὰν

text_en: and shall dip his right finger in it, and sprinkle it before the Lord seven times.
text_la: tingetque digitum dextrum in eo, et asperget coram Domino septies.
text_pt: Então o sacerdote molhará o seu dedo direito no azeite que está na sua mão esquerda, e daquele azeite com o seu dedo espargirá sete vezes perante o Senhor;
text_el: καὶ βάψει τὸν δάκτυλον τὸν δεξιὸν ἀπὸ τοῦ ἐλαίου τοῦ ὄντος ἐπὶ τῆς χειρὸς τῆς ἀριστερᾶς καὶ ῥανεῖ ἑπτάκις τῷ δακτύλῳ ἔναντι κυρίου

text_en: And the rest of the oil in his left hand, he shall pour upon the tip of the right ear of him that is cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand and the great toe of his right foot, and upon the blood that was shed for trespass:
text_la: Quod autem reliquum est olei in læva manu, fundet super extremum auriculæ dextræ ejus qui mundatur, et super pollices manus ac pedis dextri, et super sanguinem qui effusus est pro delicto,
text_pt: E o restante do azeite, que está na sua mão, o sacerdote porá sobre a ponta da orelha direita daquele que tem de purificar-se, e sobre o dedo polegar da sua mão direita, e sobre o dedo polegar do seu pé direito, em cima do sangue da expiação da culpa;
text_el: τὸ δὲ καταλειφθὲν ἔλαιον τὸ ὂν ἐν τῇ χειρὶ ἐπιθήσει ὁ ἱερεὺς ἐπὶ τὸν λοβὸν τοῦ ὠτὸς τοῦ καθαριζομένου τοῦ δεξιοῦ καὶ ἐπὶ τὸ ἄκρον τῆς χειρὸς τῆς δεξιᾶς καὶ ἐπὶ τὸ ἄκρον τοῦ ποδὸς τοῦ δεξιοῦ ἐπὶ τὸν τόπον τοῦ αἵματος τοῦ τῆς πλημμελείας

text_en: And upon his head.
text_la: et super caput ejus.
text_pt: E o restante do azeite que está na mão do sacerdote, o porá sobre a cabeça daquele que tem de purificar-se; assim o sacerdote fará expiação por ele perante o Senhor.
text_el: τὸ δὲ καταλειφθὲν ἔλαιον τὸ ἐπὶ τῆς χειρὸς τοῦ ἱερέως ἐπιθήσει ὁ ἱερεὺς ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν τοῦ καθαρισθέντος καὶ ἐξιλάσεται περὶ αὐτοῦ ὁ ἱερεὺς ἔναντι κυρίου

text_en: And he shall pray for him before the Lord , and shall offer the sacrifice for sin . Then shall he immolate the holocaust .
text_la: Rogabitque pro eo coram Domino, et faciet sacrificium pro peccato : tunc immolabit holocaustum,
text_pt: Também o sacerdote fará a expiação do pecado, e fará expiação por aquele que tem de purificar-se da sua imundícia; e depois degolará o holocausto;
text_el: καὶ ποιήσει ὁ ἱερεὺς τὸ περὶ τῆς ἁμαρτίας καὶ ἐξιλάσεται ὁ ἱερεὺς περὶ τοῦ ἀκαθάρτου τοῦ καθαριζομένου ἀπὸ τῆς ἁμαρτίας αὐτοῦ καὶ μετὰ τοῦτο σφάξει ὁ ἱερεὺς τὸ ὁλοκαύτωμα

text_en: And put it on the altar with the libations thereof: and the man shall be rightly cleansed.
text_la: et ponet illud in altari cum libamentis suis, et homo rite mundabitur.
text_pt: E o sacerdote oferecerá o holocausto e a oferta de alimentos sobre o altar; assim o sacerdote fará expiação por ele, e será limpo.
text_el: καὶ ἀνοίσει ὁ ἱερεὺς τὸ ὁλοκαύτωμα καὶ τὴν θυσίαν ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον ἔναντι κυρίου καὶ ἐξιλάσεται περὶ αὐτοῦ ὁ ἱερεύς καὶ καθαρισθήσεται

text_en: But if he be poor , and his hand cannot find the things aforesaid: he shall take a lamb for an offering for trespass, that the priest may pray for him, and a tenth part of flour tempered with oil for a sacrifice , and a sextary of oil:
text_la: Quod si pauper est, et non potest manus ejus invenire quæ dicta sunt pro delicto, assumet agnum ad oblationem, ut roget pro eo sacerdos, decimamque partem similæ conspersæ oleo in sacrificium, et olei sextarium,
text_pt: Porém se for pobre, e em sua mão não houver recursos para tanto, tomará um cordeiro para expiação da culpa em oferta de movimento, para fazer expiação por ele, e a dízima de flor de farinha, amassada com azeite, para oferta de alimentos, e um logue de azeite,
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ πένηται καὶ ἡ χεὶρ αὐτοῦ μὴ εὑρίσκῃ λήμψεται ἀμνὸν ἕνα εἰς ὃ ἐπλημμέλησεν εἰς ἀφαίρεμα ὥστε ἐξιλάσασθαι περὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ δέκατον σεμιδάλεως πεφυραμένης ἐν ἐλαίῳ εἰς θυσίαν καὶ κοτύλην ἐλαίου μίαν

text_en: And two turtles or two young pigeons, of which one may be for sin , and the other for a holocaust .
text_la: duosque turtures sive duos pullos columbæ, quorum unus sit pro peccato, et alter in holocaustum:
text_pt: E duas rolas, ou dois pombinhos, conforme as suas posses, dos quais um será para expiação do pecado, e o outro para holocausto.
text_el: καὶ δύο τρυγόνας ἢ δύο νεοσσοὺς περιστερῶν ὅσα εὗρεν ἡ χεὶρ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔσται ἡ μία περὶ ἁμαρτίας καὶ ἡ μία εἰς ὁλοκαύτωμα

text_en: And he shall offer them on the eighth day of his purification to the priest , at the door of the tabernacle of the testimony before the Lord .
text_la: offeretque ea die octavo purificationis suæ sacerdoti, ad ostium tabernaculi testimonii coram Domino.
text_pt: E ao oitavo dia da sua purificação os trará ao sacerdote, à porta da tenda da congregação, perante o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ προσοίσει αὐτὰ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ὀγδόῃ εἰς τὸ καθαρίσαι αὐτὸν πρὸς τὸν ἱερέα ἐπὶ τὴν θύραν τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου ἔναντι κυρίου

text_en: And the priest receiving the lamb for trespass, and the sextary of oil, shall elevate them together.
text_la: Qui suscipiens agnum pro delicto et sextarium olei, levabit simul:
text_pt: E o sacerdote tomará o cordeiro da expiação da culpa, e o logue de azeite, e os oferecerá por oferta movida perante o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ λαβὼν ὁ ἱερεὺς τὸν ἀμνὸν τῆς πλημμελείας καὶ τὴν κοτύλην τοῦ ἐλαίου ἐπιθήσει αὐτὰ ἐπίθεμα ἔναντι κυρίου

text_en: And the lamb being immolated, he shall put of the blood thereof upon the tip of the right ear of him that is cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and the great toe of his right foot.
text_la: immolatoque agno, de sanguine ejus ponet super extremum auriculæ dextræ illius qui mundatur, et super pollices manus ejus ac pedis dextri:
text_pt: Então degolará o cordeiro da expiação da culpa, e o sacerdote tomará do sangue da expiação da culpa, e o porá sobre a ponta da orelha direita daquele que tem de purificar-se, e sobre o dedo polegar da sua mão direita, e sobre o dedo polegar do seu pé direito.
text_el: καὶ σφάξει τὸν ἀμνὸν τῆς πλημμελείας καὶ λήμψεται ὁ ἱερεὺς ἀπὸ τοῦ αἵματος τοῦ τῆς πλημμελείας καὶ ἐπιθήσει ἐπὶ τὸν λοβὸν τοῦ ὠτὸς τοῦ καθαριζομένου τοῦ δεξιοῦ καὶ ἐπὶ τὸ ἄκρον τῆς χειρὸς τῆς δεξιᾶς καὶ ἐπὶ τὸ ἄκρον τοῦ ποδὸς τοῦ δεξιοῦ

text_en: But he shall pour part of the oil into his own left hand,
text_la: olei vero partem mittet in manum suam sinistram,
text_pt: Também o sacerdote derramará do azeite na palma da sua própria mão esquerda.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ ἐλαίου ἐπιχεεῖ ὁ ἱερεὺς ἐπὶ τὴν χεῖρα τοῦ ἱερέως τὴν ἀριστεράν

text_en: and dipping the finger of his right hand in it, he shall sprinkle it seven times before the Lord .
text_la: in quo tingens digitum dextræ manus asperget septies coram Domino:
text_pt: Depois o sacerdote com o seu dedo direito espargirá do azeite que está na sua mão esquerda, sete vezes perante o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ῥανεῖ ὁ ἱερεὺς τῷ δακτύλῳ τῷ δεξιῷ ἀπὸ τοῦ ἐλαίου τοῦ ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ τῇ ἀριστερᾷ ἑπτάκις ἔναντι κυρίου

text_en: And he shall touch the tip of the right ear of him that is cleansed, and the thumb of his right hand and the great toe of his right foot, in the place of the blood that was shed for trespass.
text_la: tangetque extremum dextræ auriculæ illius qui mundatur, et pollices manus ac pedis dextri, in loco sanguinis qui effusus est pro delicto:
text_pt: E o sacerdote porá do azeite que está na sua mão na ponta da orelha direita daquele que tem de purificar-se, e no dedo polegar da sua mão direita, e no dedo polegar do seu pé direito; no lugar do sangue da expiação da culpa.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιθήσει ὁ ἱερεὺς ἀπὸ τοῦ ἐλαίου τοῦ ἐπὶ τῆς χειρὸς αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὸν λοβὸν τοῦ ὠτὸς τοῦ καθαριζομένου τοῦ δεξιοῦ καὶ ἐπὶ τὸ ἄκρον τῆς χειρὸς αὐτοῦ τῆς δεξιᾶς καὶ ἐπὶ τὸ ἄκρον τοῦ ποδὸς αὐτοῦ τοῦ δεξιοῦ ἐπὶ τὸν τόπον τοῦ αἵματος τοῦ τῆς πλημμελείας

text_en: And the other part of the oil that is in his left hand, he shall pour upon the head of the purified person, that he may appease the Lord for him.
text_la: reliquam autem partem olei, quæ est in sinistra manu, mittet super caput purificati, ut placet pro eo Dominum:
text_pt: E o que sobejar do azeite que está na mão do sacerdote porá sobre a cabeça daquele que tem de purificar-se, para fazer expiação por ele perante o Senhor.
text_el: τὸ δὲ καταλειφθὲν ἀπὸ τοῦ ἐλαίου τὸ ὂν ἐπὶ τῆς χειρὸς τοῦ ἱερέως ἐπιθήσει ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν τοῦ καθαρισθέντος καὶ ἐξιλάσεται περὶ αὐτοῦ ὁ ἱερεὺς ἔναντι κυρίου

text_en: And he shall offer a turtle, or young pigeon:
text_la: et turturem sive pullum columbæ offeret,
text_pt: Depois oferecerá uma das rolas ou um dos pombinhos, conforme suas posses,
text_el: καὶ ποιήσει μίαν τῶν τρυγόνων ἢ ἀπὸ τῶν νεοσσῶν τῶν περιστερῶν καθότι εὗρεν αὐτοῦ ἡ χείρ

text_en: One for trespass, and the other for a holocaust , with their libations.
text_la: unum pro delicto, et alterum in holocaustum cum libamentis suis.
text_pt: Sim, conforme as suas posses, será um para expiação do pecado e o outro para holocausto com a oferta de alimentos; e assim o sacerdote fará expiação por aquele que tem de purificar-se perante o Senhor.
text_el: τὴν μίαν περὶ ἁμαρτίας καὶ τὴν μίαν εἰς ὁλοκαύτωμα σὺν τῇ θυσίᾳ καὶ ἐξιλάσεται ὁ ἱερεὺς περὶ τοῦ καθαριζομένου ἔναντι κυρίου

text_en: This is the sacrifice of a leper , that is not able to have all things that appertain to his cleansing.
text_la: Hoc est sacrificium leprosi, qui habere non potest omnia in emundationem sui.
text_pt: Esta é a lei daquele em quem estiver a praga da lepra, cujas posses não lhe permitirem o devido para purificação.
text_el: οὗτος ὁ νόμος ἐν ᾧ ἐστιν ἡ ἁφὴ τῆς λέπρας καὶ τοῦ μὴ εὑρίσκοντος τῇ χειρὶ εἰς τὸν καθαρισμὸν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron , saying:
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen et Aaron, dicens:
text_pt: Falou mais o Senhor a Moisés e a Arão, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν καὶ Ααρων λέγων

text_en: When you shall come into the land of Chanaan , which I will give you for a possession, if there be the plague or leprosy in a house:
text_la: Cum ingressi fueritis terram Chanaan, quam ego dabo vobis in possessionem, si fuerit plaga lepræ in ædibus,
text_pt: Quando tiverdes entrado na terra de Canaã que vos hei de dar por possessão, e eu enviar a praga da lepra em alguma casa da terra da vossa possessão,
text_el: ὡς ἂν εἰσέλθητε εἰς τὴν γῆν τῶν Χαναναίων ἣν ἐγὼ δίδωμι ὑμῖν ἐν κτήσει καὶ δώσω ἁφὴν λέπρας ἐν ταῖς οἰκίαις τῆς γῆς τῆς ἐγκτήτου ὑμῖν

text_en: He whose house it is, shall go and tell the priest , saying: It seems to me, that there is the plague of leprosy in my house,
text_la: ibit cujus est domus, nuntians sacerdoti, et dicet : Quasi plaga lepræ videtur mihi esse in domo mea.
text_pt: Então aquele, de quem for a casa, virá e informará ao sacerdote, dizendo: Parece-me que há como que praga em minha casa.
text_el: καὶ ἥξει τίνος αὐτοῦ ἡ οἰκία καὶ ἀναγγελεῖ τῷ ἱερεῖ λέγων ὥσπερ ἁφὴ ἑώραταί μου ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ

text_en: and he shall command, that they carry forth all things out of the house, before he go into it, and see whether it have the leprosy , let all things become unclean that are in the house. And afterwards he shall go in to view the leprosy of the house.
text_la: At ille præcipiet ut efferant universa de domo, priusquam ingrediatur eam, et videat utrum leprosa sit, ne immunda fiant omnia quæ in domo sunt. Intrabitque postea ut consideret lepram domus:
text_pt: E o sacerdote ordenará que desocupem a casa, antes que entre para examinar a praga, para que tudo o que está na casa não seja contaminado; e depois entrará o sacerdote, para examinar a casa;
text_el: καὶ προστάξει ὁ ἱερεὺς ἀποσκευάσαι τὴν οἰκίαν πρὸ τοῦ εἰσελθόντα ἰδεῖν τὸν ἱερέα τὴν ἁφὴν καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀκάθαρτα γένηται ὅσα ἐὰν ᾖ ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα εἰσελεύσεται ὁ ἱερεὺς καταμαθεῖν τὴν οἰκίαν

text_en: And if he see in the walls thereof as it were little dints, disfigured with paleness or redness, and lower than all he rest:
text_la: et cum viderit in parietibus illius quasi valliculas pallore sive rubore deformes, et humiliores superficie reliqua,
text_pt: E, vendo a praga, e eis que se ela estiver nas paredes da casa em covinhas verdes ou vermelhas, e parecerem mais fundas do que a parede,
text_el: καὶ ὄψεται τὴν ἁφὴν ἐν τοῖς τοίχοις τῆς οἰκίας κοιλάδας χλωριζούσας ἢ πυρριζούσας καὶ ἡ ὄψις αὐτῶν ταπεινοτέρα τῶν τοίχων

text_en: He shall go out of the door of the house, and forthwith shut it up seven days,
text_la: egredietur ostium domus, et statim claudet illam septem diebus.
text_pt: Então o sacerdote sairá da casa para fora da porta, e fechá-la-á por sete dias.
text_el: καὶ ἐξελθὼν ὁ ἱερεὺς ἐκ τῆς οἰκίας ἐπὶ τὴν θύραν τῆς οἰκίας καὶ ἀφοριεῖ ὁ ἱερεὺς τὴν οἰκίαν ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας

text_en: and returning on the seventh day, he shall look upon it. If he find that the leprosy is spread,
text_la: Reversusque die septimo, considerabit eam : si invenerit crevisse lepram,
text_pt: Depois, ao sétimo dia o sacerdote voltará, e examinará; e se vir que a praga nas paredes da casa se tem estendido,
text_el: καὶ ἐπανήξει ὁ ἱερεὺς τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἑβδόμῃ καὶ ὄψεται τὴν οἰκίαν καὶ ἰδοὺ οὐ διεχύθη ἡ ἁφὴ ἐν τοῖς τοίχοις τῆς οἰκίας

text_en: he shall command, that the stones wherein the leprosy is, be taken out, and cast without the city into an unclean place:
text_la: jubebit erui lapides in quibus lepra est, et projici eos extra civitatem in locum immundum:
text_pt: Então o sacerdote ordenará que arranquem as pedras, em que estiver a praga, e que as lancem fora da cidade, num lugar imundo;
text_el: καὶ προστάξει ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ ἐξελοῦσιν τοὺς λίθους ἐν οἷς ἐστιν ἡ ἁφή καὶ ἐκβαλοῦσιν αὐτοὺς ἔξω τῆς πόλεως εἰς τόπον ἀκάθαρτον

text_en: And that the house be scraped on the inside round about, and the dust of the scrapings be scattered without the city into an unclean place:
text_la: domum autem ipsam radi intrinsecus per circuitum, et spargi pulverem rasuræ extra urbem in locum immundum,
text_pt: E fará raspar a casa por dentro ao redor, e o pó que houverem raspado lançarão fora da cidade, num lugar imundo;
text_el: καὶ ἀποξύσουσιν τὴν οἰκίαν ἔσωθεν κύκλῳ καὶ ἐκχεοῦσιν τὸν χοῦν ἔξω τῆς πόλεως εἰς τόπον ἀκάθαρτον

text_en: And that other stones be laid in the place of them that were taken away, and the house be plastered with other mortar.
text_la: lapidesque alios reponi pro his qui ablati fuerint, et luto alio liniri domum.
text_pt: Depois tomarão outras pedras, e as porão no lugar das primeiras pedras; e outro barro se tomará, e a casa se rebocará.
text_el: καὶ λήμψονται λίθους ἀπεξυσμένους ἑτέρους καὶ ἀντιθήσουσιν ἀντὶ τῶν λίθων καὶ χοῦν ἕτερον λήμψονται καὶ ἐξαλείψουσιν τὴν οἰκίαν

text_en: But if after the stones be taken out, and the dust scraped off, and it be plastered with other earth.
text_la: Sin autem postquam eruti sunt lapides, et pulvis erasus, et alia terra lita,
text_pt: Porém, se a praga tornar a brotar na casa, depois de arrancadas as pedras e raspada a casa, e de novo rebocada,
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἐπέλθῃ πάλιν ἁφὴ καὶ ἀνατείλῃ ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ μετὰ τὸ ἐξελεῖν τοὺς λίθους καὶ μετὰ τὸ ἀποξυσθῆναι τὴν οἰκίαν καὶ μετὰ τὸ ἐξαλειφθῆναι

text_en: The priest going in perceive that the leprosy is returned, and the walls full of spots, it is a lasting leprosy , and the house is unclean .
text_la: ingressus sacerdos viderit reversam lepram, et parietes respersos maculis, lepra est perseverans, et immunda domus:
text_pt: Então o sacerdote entrará e examinará, se a praga na casa se tem estendido, lepra roedora há na casa; imunda está.
text_el: καὶ εἰσελεύσεται ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ ὄψεται εἰ διακέχυται ἡ ἁφὴ ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ λέπρα ἔμμονός ἐστιν ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ ἀκάθαρτός ἐστιν

text_en: And they shall destroy it forthwith, and shall cast the stones and timber thereof, and all the dust without the town into an unclean place.
text_la: quam statim destruent, et lapides ejus ac ligna, atque universum pulverem projicient extra oppidum in locum immundum.
text_pt: Portanto se derribará a casa, as suas pedras, e a sua madeira, como também todo o barro da casa; e se levará para fora da cidade a um lugar imundo.
text_el: καὶ καθελοῦσιν τὴν οἰκίαν καὶ τὰ ξύλα αὐτῆς καὶ τοὺς λίθους αὐτῆς καὶ πάντα τὸν χοῦν ἐξοίσουσιν ἔξω τῆς πόλεως εἰς τόπον ἀκάθαρτον

text_en: He that enters into the house when it is shut, shall be unclean until evening,
text_la: Qui intraverit domum quando clausa est, immundus erit usque ad vesperum:
text_pt: E o que entrar naquela casa, em qualquer dia em que estiver fechada, será imundo até à tarde.
text_el: καὶ ὁ εἰσπορευόμενος εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας ἃς ἀφωρισμένη ἐστίν ἀκάθαρτος ἔσται ἕως ἑσπέρας

text_en: and he that sleeps in it, and eats anything, shall wash his clothes.
text_la: et qui dormierit in ea, et comederit quippiam, lavabit vestimenta sua.
text_pt: Também o que se deitar a dormir em tal casa, lavará as suas roupas; e o que comer em tal casa lavará as suas roupas.
text_el: καὶ ὁ κοιμώμενος ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ πλυνεῖ τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀκάθαρτος ἔσται ἕως ἑσπέρας καὶ ὁ ἔσθων ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ πλυνεῖ τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀκάθαρτος ἔσται ἕως ἑσπέρας

text_en: But if the priest going in perceive that the leprosy is not spread in the house, after it was plastered again, he shall purify it, it being cured.
text_la: Quod si introiens sacerdos viderit lepram non crevisse in domo, postquam denuo lita fuerit, purificabit eam reddita sanitate:
text_pt: Porém, tornando o sacerdote a entrar na casa e examinando-a, se a praga não se tem estendido, depois que a casa foi rebocada, o sacerdote a declarará por limpa, porque a praga está curada.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ παραγενόμενος εἰσέλθῃ ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ ἴδῃ καὶ ἰδοὺ διαχύσει οὐ διαχεῖται ἡ ἁφὴ ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ μετὰ τὸ ἐξαλειφθῆναι τὴν οἰκίαν καὶ καθαριεῖ ὁ ἱερεὺς τὴν οἰκίαν ὅτι ἰάθη ἡ ἁφή

text_en: And for the purification thereof he shall take two sparrows, and cedar wood , and scarlet, and hyssop .
text_la: et in purificationem ejus sumet duos passeres, lignumque cedrinum, et vermiculum atque hyssopum:
text_pt: Depois tomará, para expiar a casa, duas aves, e pau de cedro, e carmesim e hissopo;
text_el: καὶ λήμψεται ἀφαγνίσαι τὴν οἰκίαν δύο ὀρνίθια ζῶντα καθαρὰ καὶ ξύλον κέδρινον καὶ κεκλωσμένον κόκκινον καὶ ὕσσωπον

text_en: And having immolated one sparrow in an earthen vessel, over living waters,
text_la: et immolato uno passere in vase fictili super aquas vivas,
text_pt: E degolará uma ave num vaso de barro sobre águas correntes;
text_el: καὶ σφάξει τὸ ὀρνίθιον τὸ ἓν εἰς σκεῦος ὀστράκινον ἐφ' ὕδατι ζῶντι

text_en: he shall take the cedar wood , and the hyssop , and the scarlet, and the living sparrow, and shall dip all in the blood of the sparrow that is immolated, and in the living water: and he shall sprinkle the house seven times.
text_la: tollet lignum cedrinum, et hyssopum, et coccum, et passerem vivum, et tinget omnia in sanguine passeris immolati, atque in aquis viventibus, et asperget domum septies,
text_pt: Então tomará pau de cedro, e o hissopo, e o carmesim, e a ave viva, e os molhará no sangue da ave degolada e nas águas correntes, e espargirá a casa sete vezes;
text_el: καὶ λήμψεται τὸ ξύλον τὸ κέδρινον καὶ τὸ κεκλωσμένον κόκκινον καὶ τὸν ὕσσωπον καὶ τὸ ὀρνίθιον τὸ ζῶν καὶ βάψει αὐτὸ εἰς τὸ αἷμα τοῦ ὀρνιθίου τοῦ ἐσφαγμένου ἐφ' ὕδατι ζῶντι καὶ περιρρανεῖ ἐν αὐτοῖς ἐπὶ τὴν οἰκίαν ἑπτάκις

text_en: And shall purify it as well with the blood of the sparrow, as with the living water, and with the living sparrow, and with the cedar wood , and the hyssop , and the scarlet.
text_la: purificabitque eam tam in sanguine passeris quam in aquis viventibus, et in passere vivo, lignoque cedrino et hyssopo atque vermiculo.
text_pt: Assim expiará aquela casa com o sangue da ave, e com as águas correntes, e com a ave viva, e com o pau de cedro, e com o hissopo, e com o carmesim.
text_el: καὶ ἀφαγνιεῖ τὴν οἰκίαν ἐν τῷ αἵματι τοῦ ὀρνιθίου καὶ ἐν τῷ ὕδατι τῷ ζῶντι καὶ ἐν τῷ ὀρνιθίῳ τῷ ζῶντι καὶ ἐν τῷ ξύλῳ τῷ κεδρίνῳ καὶ ἐν τῷ ὑσσώπῳ καὶ ἐν τῷ κεκλωσμένῳ κοκκίνῳ

text_en: And when he has let go the sparrow to fly freely away into the field, he shall pray for the house: and it shall be rightly cleansed.
text_la: Cumque dimiserit passerem avolare in agrum libere, orabit pro domo, et jure mundabitur.
text_pt: Então soltará a ave viva para fora da cidade, sobre a face do campo; assim fará expiação pela casa, e será limpa.
text_el: καὶ ἐξαποστελεῖ τὸ ὀρνίθιον τὸ ζῶν ἔξω τῆς πόλεως εἰς τὸ πεδίον καὶ ἐξιλάσεται περὶ τῆς οἰκίας καὶ καθαρὰ ἔσται

text_en: This is the law of every kind of leprosy and stroke.
text_la: Ista est lex omnis lepræ et percussuræ,
text_pt: Esta é a lei de toda a praga da lepra, e da tinha,
text_el: οὗτος ὁ νόμος κατὰ πᾶσαν ἁφὴν λέπρας καὶ θραύσματος

text_en: Of the leprosy of garments and houses,
text_la: lepræ vestium et domorum,
text_pt: E da lepra das roupas, e das casas,
text_el: καὶ τῆς λέπρας ἱματίου καὶ οἰκίας

text_en: of a scar and of blisters breaking out of a shining spot, and when the colours are diversely changed:
text_la: cicatricis et erumpentium papularum, lucentis maculæ, et in varias species, coloribus immutatis,
text_pt: E da inchação, e das pústulas, e das manchas lustrosas;
text_el: καὶ οὐλῆς καὶ σημασίας καὶ τοῦ αὐγάζοντος

text_en: That it may be known when a thing is clean or unclean .
text_la: ut possit sciri quo tempore mundum quid, vel immundum sit.
text_pt: Para ensinar quando alguma coisa será imunda, e quando será limpa. Esta é a lei da lepra.
text_el: καὶ τοῦ ἐξηγήσασθαι ᾗ ἡμέρᾳ ἀκάθαρτον καὶ ᾗ ἡμέρᾳ καθαρισθήσεται οὗτος ὁ νόμος τῆς λέπρας

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron , saying:
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen et Aaron, dicens:
text_pt: Falou mais o SENHOR a Moisés e a Arão dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν καὶ Ααρων λέγων

text_en: Speak to the children of Israel , and say to them: The man that has an issue of seed, shall be unclean .
text_la: Loquimini filiis Israël, et dicite eis : Vir, qui patitur fluxum seminis, immundus erit.
text_pt: Falai aos filhos de Israel, e dizei-lhes: Qualquer homem que tiver fluxo da sua carne, será imundo por causa do seu fluxo.
text_el: λάλησον τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ καὶ ἐρεῖς αὐτοῖς ἀνδρὶ ἀνδρί ᾧ ἐὰν γένηται ῥύσις ἐκ τοῦ σώματος αὐτοῦ ἡ ῥύσις αὐτοῦ ἀκάθαρτός ἐστιν

text_en: And then shall he be judged subject to this evil , when a filthy humour, at every moment, cleaves to his flesh, and gathers there.
text_la: Et tunc judicabitur huic vitio subjacere, cum per singula momenta adhæserit carni ejus, atque concreverit fœdus humor.
text_pt: Esta, pois, será a sua imundícia, por causa do seu fluxo; se a sua carne vasa o seu fluxo ou se a sua carne estanca o seu fluxo, esta é a sua imundícia.
text_el: καὶ οὗτος ὁ νόμος τῆς ἀκαθαρσίας αὐτοῦ ῥέων γόνον ἐκ σώματος αὐτοῦ ἐκ τῆς ῥύσεως ἧς συνέστηκεν τὸ σῶμα αὐτοῦ διὰ τῆς ῥύσεως αὕτη ἡ ἀκαθαρσία αὐτοῦ ἐν αὐτῷ πᾶσαι αἱ ἡμέραι ῥύσεως σώματος αὐτοῦ ᾗ συνέστηκεν τὸ σῶμα αὐτοῦ διὰ τῆς ῥύσεως ἀκαθαρσία αὐτοῦ ἐστιν

text_en: Every bed on which he sleeps, shall be unclean , and every place on which he sits.
text_la: Omne stratum, in quo dormierit, immundum erit, et ubicumque sederit.
text_pt: Toda a cama, em que se deitar o que tiver fluxo, será imunda; e toda a coisa, sobre o que se assentar, será imunda.
text_el: πᾶσα κοίτη ἐφ' ᾗ ἐὰν κοιμηθῇ ἐπ' αὐτῆς ὁ γονορρυής ἀκάθαρτός ἐστιν καὶ πᾶν σκεῦος ἐφ' ὃ ἐὰν καθίσῃ ἐπ' αὐτὸ ὁ γονορρυής ἀκάθαρτον ἔσται

text_en: If any man touch his bed, he shall wash his clothes and being washed with water, he shall be unclean until the evening.
text_la: Si quis hominum tetigerit lectum ejus, lavabit vestimenta sua, et ipse lotus aqua, immundus erit usque ad vesperum.
text_pt: E qualquer que tocar a sua cama, lavará as suas roupas, e se banhará em água, e será imundo até à tarde.
text_el: καὶ ἄνθρωπος ὃς ἂν ἅψηται τῆς κοίτης αὐτοῦ πλυνεῖ τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ καὶ λούσεται ὕδατι καὶ ἀκάθαρτος ἔσται ἕως ἑσπέρας

text_en: If a man sit where that man has sitten, he also shall wash his clothes: and being washed with water, shall be unclean until the evening.
text_la: Si sederit ubi ille sederat, et ipse lavabit vestimenta sua : et lotus aqua, immundus erit usque ad vesperum.
text_pt: E aquele que se assentar sobre aquilo em que se assentou o que tem o fluxo, lavará as suas roupas, e se banhará em água, e será imundo até à tarde.
text_el: καὶ ὁ καθήμενος ἐπὶ τοῦ σκεύους ἐφ' ὃ ἐὰν καθίσῃ ὁ γονορρυής πλυνεῖ τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ καὶ λούσεται ὕδατι καὶ ἀκάθαρτος ἔσται ἕως ἑσπέρας

text_en: He that touches his flesh, shall wash his clothes: and being himself washed with water shall be unclean until the evening.
text_la: Qui tetigerit carnem ejus, lavabit vestimenta sua : et ipse lotus aqua, immundus erit usque ad vesperum.
text_pt: E aquele que tocar a carne do que tem o fluxo, lavará as suas roupas, e se banhará em água, e será imundo até à tarde.
text_el: καὶ ὁ ἁπτόμενος τοῦ χρωτὸς τοῦ γονορρυοῦς πλυνεῖ τὰ ἱμάτια καὶ λούσεται ὕδατι καὶ ἀκάθαρτος ἔσται ἕως ἑσπέρας

text_en: If such a man cast his spittle upon him that is clean , he shall wash his clothes: and being washed with water, he shall be unclean until the evening.
text_la: Si salivam hujuscemodi homo jecerit super eum qui mundus est, lavabit vestimenta sua : et lotus aqua, immundus erit usque ad vesperum.
text_pt: Quando também o que tem o fluxo cuspir sobre um limpo, então lavará este as suas roupas, e se banhará em água, e será imundo até à tarde.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ προσσιελίσῃ ὁ γονορρυὴς ἐπὶ τὸν καθαρόν πλυνεῖ τὰ ἱμάτια καὶ λούσεται ὕδατι καὶ ἀκάθαρτος ἔσται ἕως ἑσπέρας

text_en: The saddle on which he has sitten shall be unclean .
text_la: Sagma, super quo sederit, immundum erit:
text_pt: Também toda a sela, em que cavalgar o que tem o fluxo, será imunda.
text_el: καὶ πᾶν ἐπίσαγμα ὄνου ἐφ' ὃ ἂν ἐπιβῇ ἐπ' αὐτὸ ὁ γονορρυής ἀκάθαρτον ἔσται ἕως ἑσπέρας

text_en: And whatsoever has been under him that has the issue of seed, shall be unclean until the evening. He that carries any of these things, shall wash his clothes: and being washed with water, he shall be unclean until the evening.
text_la: et quidquid sub eo fuerit, qui fluxum seminis patitur, pollutum erit usque ad vesperum. Qui portaverit horum aliquid, lavabit vestimenta sua : et ipse lotus aqua, immundus erit usque ad vesperum.
text_pt: E qualquer que tocar em alguma coisa que esteve debaixo dele, será imundo até à tarde; e aquele que a levar, lavará as suas roupas, e se banhará em água, e será imundo até à tarde.
text_el: καὶ πᾶς ὁ ἁπτόμενος ὅσα ἐὰν ᾖ ὑποκάτω αὐτοῦ ἀκάθαρτος ἔσται ἕως ἑσπέρας καὶ ὁ αἴρων αὐτὰ πλυνεῖ τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ καὶ λούσεται ὕδατι καὶ ἀκάθαρτος ἔσται ἕως ἑσπέρας

text_en: Every person whom such a one shall touch, not having washed his hands before, shall wash his clothes: and being washed with water, shall be unclean until the evening.
text_la: Omnis, quem tetigerit qui talis est, non lotis ante manibus, lavabit vestimenta sua, et lotus aqua, immundus erit usque ad vesperum.
text_pt: Também todo aquele em quem tocar o que tem o fluxo, sem haver lavado as suas mãos com água, lavará as suas roupas, e se banhará em água, e será imundo até à tarde.
text_el: καὶ ὅσων ἐὰν ἅψηται ὁ γονορρυὴς καὶ τὰς χεῖρας οὐ νένιπται πλυνεῖ τὰ ἱμάτια καὶ λούσεται τὸ σῶμα ὕδατι καὶ ἀκάθαρτος ἔσται ἕως ἑσπέρας

text_en: If he touch a vessel of earth, it shall be broken: but if a vessel of wood, it shall be washed with water.
text_la: Vas fictile quod tetigerit confringetur: vas autem ligneum lavabitur aqua.
text_pt: E o vaso de barro, que tocar o que tem o fluxo, será quebrado; porém, todo o vaso de madeira será lavado com água.
text_el: καὶ σκεῦος ὀστράκινον οὗ ἂν ἅψηται ὁ γονορρυής συντριβήσεται καὶ σκεῦος ξύλινον νιφήσεται ὕδατι καὶ καθαρὸν ἔσται

text_en: If he who suffers this disease be healed, he shall number seven days after his cleansing: and having washed his clothes, and all his body in living water, he shall be clean.
text_la: Si sanatus fuerit qui hujuscemodi sustinet passionem, numerabit septem dies post emundationem sui, et lotis vestibus et toto corpore in aquis viventibus, erit mundus.
text_pt: Quando, pois, o que tem o fluxo, estiver limpo do seu fluxo, contar-se-ão sete dias para a sua purificação, e lavará as suas roupas, e banhará a sua carne em águas correntes; e será limpo.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ καθαρισθῇ ὁ γονορρυὴς ἐκ τῆς ῥύσεως αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐξαριθμήσεται αὐτῷ ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας εἰς τὸν καθαρισμὸν καὶ πλυνεῖ τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ καὶ λούσεται τὸ σῶμα ὕδατι καὶ καθαρὸς ἔσται

text_en: And on the eighth day he shall take two turtles, or two young pigeons, and he shall come before the Lord , to the door of the tabernacle of the testimony , and shall give them to the priest .
text_la: Die autem octavo sumet duos turtures, aut duos pullos columbæ, et veniet in conspectum Domini ad ostium tabernaculi testimonii, dabitque eos sacerdoti:
text_pt: E ao oitavo dia tomará duas rolas ou dois pombinhos, e virá perante o Senhor, à porta da tenda da congregação e os dará ao sacerdote;
text_el: καὶ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ὀγδόῃ λήμψεται ἑαυτῷ δύο τρυγόνας ἢ δύο νεοσσοὺς περιστερῶν καὶ οἴσει αὐτὰ ἔναντι κυρίου ἐπὶ τὰς θύρας τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου καὶ δώσει αὐτὰ τῷ ἱερεῖ

text_en: Who shall offer one for sin , and the other for a holocaust : and he shall pray for him before the Lord , that he may be cleansed of the issue of his seed.
text_la: qui faciet unum pro peccato et alterum in holocaustum : rogabitque pro eo coram Domino, ut emundetur a fluxi seminis sui.
text_pt: E o sacerdote oferecerá um para expiação do pecado, e o outro para holocausto; e assim o sacerdote fará por ele expiação do seu fluxo perante o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσει αὐτὰ ὁ ἱερεύς μίαν περὶ ἁμαρτίας καὶ μίαν εἰς ὁλοκαύτωμα καὶ ἐξιλάσεται περὶ αὐτοῦ ὁ ἱερεὺς ἔναντι κυρίου ἀπὸ τῆς ῥύσεως αὐτοῦ

text_en: The man from whom the seed of copulation goes out, shall wash all his body with water: and he shall be unclean until the evening.
text_la: Vir de quo egreditur semen coitus, lavabit aqua omne corpus suum : et immundus erit usque ad vesperum.
text_pt: Também o homem, quando sair dele o sêmen da cópula, toda a sua carne banhará com água, e será imundo até à tarde.
text_el: καὶ ἄνθρωπος ᾧ ἐὰν ἐξέλθῃ ἐξ αὐτοῦ κοίτη σπέρματος καὶ λούσεται ὕδατι πᾶν τὸ σῶμα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀκάθαρτος ἔσται ἕως ἑσπέρας

text_en: The garment or skin that he wears, he shall wash with water: and it shall be unclean until the evening.
text_la: Vestem et pellem, quam habuerit, lavabit aqua, et immunda erit usque ad vesperum.
text_pt: Também toda a roupa, e toda a pele em que houver sêmen da cópula se lavará com água, e será imundo até à tarde.
text_el: καὶ πᾶν ἱμάτιον καὶ πᾶν δέρμα ἐφ' ὃ ἐὰν ᾖ ἐπ' αὐτὸ κοίτη σπέρματος καὶ πλυθήσεται ὕδατι καὶ ἀκάθαρτον ἔσται ἕως ἑσπέρας

text_en: The woman , with whom he copulates, shall be washed with water: and shall be unclean until the evening.
text_la: Mulier, cum qua coierit, lavabitur aqua, et immunda erit usque ad vesperum.
text_pt: E também se um homem se deitar com a mulher e tiver emissão de sêmen, ambos se banharão com água, e serão imundos até à tarde.
text_el: καὶ γυνή ἐὰν κοιμηθῇ ἀνὴρ μετ' αὐτῆς κοίτην σπέρματος καὶ λούσονται ὕδατι καὶ ἀκάθαρτοι ἔσονται ἕως ἑσπέρας

text_en: The woman , who at the return of the month, has her issue of blood, shall be separated seven days.
text_la: Mulier, quæ redeunte mense patitur fluxum sanguinis, septem diebus separabitur.
