text_en: He that shall copulate with any beast or cattle, dying let him die: the beast also you shall kill.
text_la: Qui cum jumento et pecore coierit, morte moriatur : pecus quoque occidite.
text_pt: Quando também um homem se deitar com um animal, certamente morrerá; e matareis o animal.
text_el: καὶ ὃς ἂν δῷ κοιτασίαν αὐτοῦ ἐν τετράποδι θανάτῳ θανατούσθω καὶ τὸ τετράπουν ἀποκτενεῖτε

text_en: The woman that shall lie under any beast, shall be killed together with the same. Their blood be upon them.
text_la: Mulier, quæ succubuerit cuilibet jumento, simul interficietur cum eo : sanguis eorum sit super eos.
text_pt: Também a mulher que se chegar a algum animal, para ajuntar-se com ele, aquela mulher matarás bem assim como o animal; certamente morrerão; o seu sangue será sobre eles.
text_el: καὶ γυνή ἥτις προσελεύσεται πρὸς πᾶν κτῆνος βιβασθῆναι αὐτὴν ὑπ' αὐτοῦ ἀποκτενεῖτε τὴν γυναῖκα καὶ τὸ κτῆνος θανάτῳ θανατούσθωσαν ἔνοχοί εἰσιν

text_en: If any man take his sister, the daughter of his father, or the daughter of his mother, and see her nakedness, and she behold her brother's shame: they have committed a crime . They shall be slain, in the sight of their people, because they have discovered one another's nakedness. And they shall bear their iniquity .
text_la: Qui acceperit sororem suam filiam patris sui, vel filiam matris suæ, et viderit turpitudinem ejus, illaque conspexerit fratris ignominiam, nefariam rem operati sunt : occidentur in conspectu populi sui, eo quod turpitudinem suam mutuo revelaverint, et portabunt iniquitatem suam.
text_pt: E, quando um homem tomar a sua irmã, filha de seu pai, ou filha de sua mãe, e vir a nudez dela, e ela a sua, torpeza é; portanto serão extirpados aos olhos dos filhos do seu povo; descobriu a nudez de sua irmã, levará sobre si a sua iniqüidade.
text_el: ὃς ἐὰν λάβῃ τὴν ἀδελφὴν αὐτοῦ ἐκ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ ἢ ἐκ μητρὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἴδῃ τὴν ἀσχημοσύνην αὐτῆς καὶ αὕτη ἴδῃ τὴν ἀσχημοσύνην αὐτοῦ ὄνειδός ἐστιν ἐξολεθρευθήσονται ἐνώπιον υἱῶν γένους αὐτῶν ἀσχημοσύνην ἀδελφῆς αὐτοῦ ἀπεκάλυψεν ἁμαρτίαν κομιοῦνται

text_en: If any man lie with a woman in her flowers, and uncover her nakedness, and she open the fountain of her blood: both shall be destroyed out of the midst of their people.
text_la: Qui coierit cum muliere in fluxu menstruo, et revelaverit turpitudinem ejus, ipsaque aperuerit fontem sanguinis sui, interficientur ambo de medio populi sui.
text_pt: E, quando um homem se deitar com uma mulher no tempo da sua enfermidade, e descobrir a sua nudez, descobrindo a sua fonte, e ela descobrir a fonte do seu sangue, ambos serão extirpados do meio do seu povo.
text_el: καὶ ἀνήρ ὃς ἂν κοιμηθῇ μετὰ γυναικὸς ἀποκαθημένης καὶ ἀποκαλύψῃ τὴν ἀσχημοσύνην αὐτῆς τὴν πηγὴν αὐτῆς ἀπεκάλυψεν καὶ αὕτη ἀπεκάλυψεν τὴν ῥύσιν τοῦ αἵματος αὐτῆς ἐξολεθρευθήσονται ἀμφότεροι ἐκ τοῦ γένους αὐτῶν

text_en: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your aunt by your mother, and of your aunt by your father. He that does this, has uncovered the shame of his own flesh: both shall bear their iniquity .
text_la: Turpitudinem materteræ et amitæ tuæ non discooperies : qui hoc fecerit, ignominiam carnis suæ nudavit; portabunt ambo iniquitatem suam.
text_pt: Também a nudez da irmã de tua mãe, ou da irmã de teu pai não descobrirás; porquanto descobriu a sua parenta, sobre si levarão a sua iniqüidade.
text_el: καὶ ἀσχημοσύνην ἀδελφῆς πατρός σου καὶ ἀδελφῆς μητρός σου οὐκ ἀποκαλύψεις τὴν γὰρ οἰκειότητα ἀπεκάλυψεν ἁμαρτίαν ἀποίσονται

text_en: If any man lie with the wife of his uncle by the father, or of his uncle by the mother, and uncover the shame of his near akin , both shall bear their sin . They shall die without children.
text_la: Qui coierit cum uxore patrui vel avunculi sui, et revelaverit ignominiam cognationis suæ, portabunt ambo peccatum suum : absque liberis morientur.
text_pt: Quando também um homem se deitar com a sua tia descobriu a nudez de seu tio; seu pecado sobre si levarão; sem filhos morrerão.
text_el: ὃς ἂν κοιμηθῇ μετὰ τῆς συγγενοῦς αὐτοῦ ἀσχημοσύνην τῆς συγγενείας αὐτοῦ ἀπεκάλυψεν ἄτεκνοι ἀποθανοῦνται

text_en: He that marries his brother's wife, does an unlawful thing: he has uncovered his brother's nakedness. They shall be without children.
text_la: Qui duxerit uxorem fratris sui, rem facit illicitam : turpitudinem fratris sui revelavit : absque liberis erunt.
text_pt: E quando um homem tomar a mulher de seu irmão, imundícia é; a nudez de seu irmão descobriu; sem filhos ficarão.
text_el: ὃς ἂν λάβῃ τὴν γυναῖκα τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ ἀκαθαρσία ἐστίν ἀσχημοσύνην τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ ἀπεκάλυψεν ἄτεκνοι ἀποθανοῦνται

text_en: Keep my laws and my judgments, and do them: lest the land into which you are to enter to dwell therein, vomit you also out.
text_la: Custodite leges meas, atque judicia, et facite ea : ne et vos evomat terra quam intraturi estis et habitaturi.
text_pt: Guardai, pois, todos os meus estatutos, e todos os meus juízos, e cumpri-os, para que não vos vomite a terra, para a qual eu vos levo para habitar nela.
text_el: καὶ φυλάξασθε πάντα τὰ προστάγματά μου καὶ τὰ κρίματά μου καὶ ποιήσετε αὐτά καὶ οὐ μὴ προσοχθίσῃ ὑμῖν ἡ γῆ εἰς ἣν ἐγὼ εἰσάγω ὑμᾶς ἐκεῖ κατοικεῖν ἐπ' αὐτῆς

text_en: Walk not after the laws of the nations , which I will cast out before you. For they have done all these things: and therefore I abhorred them.
text_la: Nolite ambulare in legitimis nationum, quas ego expulsurus sum ante vos. Omnia enim hæc fecerunt, et abominatus sum eas.
text_pt: E não andeis nos costumes das nações que eu expulso de diante de vós, porque fizeram todas estas coisas; portanto fui enfadado deles.
text_el: καὶ οὐχὶ πορεύεσθε τοῖς νομίμοις τῶν ἐθνῶν οὓς ἐξαποστέλλω ἀφ' ὑμῶν ὅτι ταῦτα πάντα ἐποίησαν καὶ ἐβδελυξάμην αὐτούς

text_en: But to you I say: Possess their land which I will give you for an inheritance, a land flowing with milk and honey. I am the Lord your God , who have separated you from other people.
text_la: Vobis autem loquor. Possidete terram eorum, quam dabo vobis in hæreditatem, terram fluentem lacte et melle. Ego Dominus Deus vester, qui separavi vos a ceteris populis.
text_pt: E a vós vos tenho dito: Em herança possuireis a sua terra, e eu a darei a vós, para a possuirdes, terra que mana leite e mel. Eu sou o Senhor vosso Deus, que vos separei dos povos.
text_el: καὶ εἶπα ὑμῖν ὑμεῖς κληρονομήσατε τὴν γῆν αὐτῶν καὶ ἐγὼ δώσω ὑμῖν αὐτὴν ἐν κτήσει γῆν ῥέουσαν γάλα καὶ μέλι ἐγὼ κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν ὃς διώρισα ὑμᾶς ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν ἐθνῶν

text_en: Therefore do you also separate the clean beast from the unclean , and the clean fowl from the unclean . Defile not your souls with beasts, or birds, or any things that move on the earth, and which I have shown you to be unclean :
text_la: Separate ergo et vos jumentum mundum ab immundo, et avem mundam ab immunda : ne polluatis animas vestras in pecore, et avibus, et cunctis quæ moventur in terra, et quæ vobis ostendi esse polluta.
text_pt: Fareis, pois, diferença entre os animais limpos e imundos, e entre as aves imundas e as limpas; e as vossas almas não fareis abomináveis por causa dos animais, ou das aves, ou de tudo o que se arrasta sobre a terra; as quais coisas apartei de vós, para tê-las por imundas.
text_el: καὶ ἀφοριεῖτε αὐτοὺς ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν κτηνῶν τῶν καθαρῶν καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν κτηνῶν τῶν ἀκαθάρτων καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν πετεινῶν τῶν καθαρῶν καὶ τῶν ἀκαθάρτων καὶ οὐ βδελύξετε τὰς ψυχὰς ὑμῶν ἐν τοῖς κτήνεσιν καὶ ἐν τοῖς πετεινοῖς καὶ ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἑρπετοῖς τῆς γῆς ἃ ἐγὼ ἀφώρισα ὑμῖν ἐν ἀκαθαρσίᾳ

text_en: You shall be holy unto me, because I the Lord am holy : and I have separated you from other people, that you should be mine.
text_la: Eritis mihi sancti, quia sanctus sum ego Dominus, et separavi vos a ceteris populis, ut essetis mei.
text_pt: E ser-me-eis santos, porque eu, o Senhor, sou santo, e vos separei dos povos, para serdes meus.
text_el: καὶ ἔσεσθέ μοι ἅγιοι ὅτι ἐγὼ ἅγιος κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν ὁ ἀφορίσας ὑμᾶς ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν ἐθνῶν εἶναι ἐμοί

text_en: A man , or woman , in whom there is a pythonical or divining spirit , dying let them die. They shall stone them. Their blood be upon them.
text_la: Vir, sive mulier, in quibus pythonicus, vel divinationis fuerit spiritus, morte moriantur : lapidibus obruent eos : sanguis eorum sit super illos.
text_pt: Quando, pois, algum homem ou mulher em si tiver um espírito de necromancia ou espírito de adivinhação, certamente morrerá; serão apedrejados; o seu sangue será sobre eles.
text_el: καὶ ἀνὴρ ἢ γυνή ὃς ἂν γένηται αὐτῶν ἐγγαστρίμυθος ἢ ἐπαοιδός θανάτῳ θανατούσθωσαν ἀμφότεροι λίθοις λιθοβολήσατε αὐτούς ἔνοχοί εἰσιν

text_en: The Lord said also to Moses : Speak to the priests the sons of Aaron , and you shall say for them: Let not a priest incur an uncleanness at the death of his citizens.
text_la: Dixit quoque Dominus ad Moysen : Loquere ad sacerdotes filios Aaron, et dices ad eos : Ne contaminetur sacerdos in mortibus civium suorum,
text_pt: Depois disse o SENHOR a Moisés: Fala aos sacerdotes, filhos de Arão, e dize-lhes: O sacerdote não se contaminará por causa de um morto entre o seu povo,
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων εἰπὸν τοῖς ἱερεῦσιν τοῖς υἱοῖς Ααρων καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτούς ἐν ταῖς ψυχαῖς οὐ μιανθήσονται ἐν τῷ ἔθνει αὐτῶν

text_en: But only for his kin , such as are near in blood: that is to say, for his father and for his mother, and for his son, and for his daughter, for his brother also:
text_la: nisi tantum in consanguineis, ac propinquis, id est, super patre et matre, et filio, et filia, fratre quoque,
text_pt: Salvo por seu parente mais chegado: por sua mãe, e por seu pai, e por seu filho, e por sua filha, e por seu irmão.
text_el: ἀλλ' ἢ ἐν τῷ οἰκείῳ τῷ ἔγγιστα αὐτῶν ἐπὶ πατρὶ καὶ μητρὶ καὶ υἱοῖς καὶ θυγατράσιν ἐπ' ἀδελφῷ

text_en: And for a maiden sister, who has had no husband.
text_la: et sorore virgine quæ non est nupta viro:
text_pt: E por sua irmã virgem, chegada a ele, que ainda não teve marido; por ela também se contaminará.
text_el: καὶ ἐπ' ἀδελφῇ παρθένῳ τῇ ἐγγιζούσῃ αὐτῷ τῇ μὴ ἐκδεδομένῃ ἀνδρί ἐπὶ τούτοις μιανθήσεται

text_en: But not even for the prince of his people shall he do anything that may make him unclean .
text_la: sed nec in principe populi sui contaminabitur.
text_pt: Ele sendo principal entre o seu povo, não se contaminará, pois que se profanaria.
text_el: οὐ μιανθήσεται ἐξάπινα ἐν τῷ λαῷ αὐτοῦ εἰς βεβήλωσιν αὐτοῦ

text_en: Neither shall they shave their head, nor their beard , nor make incisions in their flesh.
text_la: Non radent caput, nec barbam, neque in carnibus suis facient incisuras.
text_pt: Não farão calva na sua cabeça, e não raparão as extremidades da sua barba, nem darão golpes na sua carne.
text_el: καὶ φαλάκρωμα οὐ ξυρηθήσεσθε τὴν κεφαλὴν ἐπὶ νεκρῷ καὶ τὴν ὄψιν τοῦ πώγωνος οὐ ξυρήσονται καὶ ἐπὶ τὰς σάρκας αὐτῶν οὐ κατατεμοῦσιν ἐντομίδας

text_en: They shall be holy to their God , and shall not profane his name . For they offer the burnt offering of the Lord , and the bread of their God : and therefore they shall be holy .
text_la: Sancti erunt Deo suo, et non polluent nomen ejus : incensum enim Domini, et panes Dei sui offerunt, et ideo sancti erunt.
text_pt: Santos serão a seu Deus, e não profanarão o nome do seu Deus, porque oferecem as ofertas queimadas do Senhor, e o pão do seu Deus; portanto serão santos.
text_el: ἅγιοι ἔσονται τῷ θεῷ αὐτῶν καὶ οὐ βεβηλώσουσιν τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ θεοῦ αὐτῶν τὰς γὰρ θυσίας κυρίου δῶρα τοῦ θεοῦ αὐτῶν αὐτοὶ προσφέρουσιν καὶ ἔσονται ἅγιοι

text_en: They shall not take to wife a harlot or a vile prostitute, nor one that has been put away from her husband: because they are consecrated to their God ,
text_la: Scortum et vile prostibulum non ducent uxorem, nec eam quæ repudiata est a marito : quia consecrati sunt Deo suo,
text_pt: Não tomarão mulher prostituta ou desonrada, nem tomarão mulher repudiada de seu marido; pois santo é a seu Deus.
text_el: γυναῖκα πόρνην καὶ βεβηλωμένην οὐ λήμψονται καὶ γυναῖκα ἐκβεβλημένην ἀπὸ ἀνδρὸς αὐτῆς ἅγιός ἐστιν τῷ κυρίῳ θεῷ αὐτοῦ

text_en: and offer the loaves of proposition . Let them therefore be holy because I also am holy : the Lord , who sanctify them.
text_la: et panes propositionis offerunt. Sint ergo sancti, quia et ego sanctus sum, Dominus qui sanctifico eos.
text_pt: Portanto o santificarás, porquanto oferece o pão do teu Deus; santo será para ti, pois eu, o Senhor que vos santifica, sou santo.
text_el: καὶ ἁγιάσει αὐτόν τὰ δῶρα κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ὑμῶν οὗτος προσφέρει ἅγιος ἔσται ὅτι ἅγιος ἐγὼ κύριος ὁ ἁγιάζων αὐτούς

text_en: If the daughter of a priest be taken in whoredom and dishonour the name of her father, she shall be burnt with fire.
text_la: Sacerdotis filia si deprehensa fuerit in stupro, et violaverit nomen patris sui, flammis exuretur.
text_pt: E quando a filha de um sacerdote começar a prostituir-se, profana a seu pai; com fogo será queimada.
text_el: καὶ θυγάτηρ ἀνθρώπου ἱερέως ἐὰν βεβηλωθῇ τοῦ ἐκπορνεῦσαι τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτῆς αὐτὴ βεβηλοῖ ἐπὶ πυρὸς κατακαυθήσεται

text_en: The high priest , that is to say, the priest who is the greatest among his brethren, upon whose head the oil of unction has been poured; and whose hands have been consecrated for the priesthood ; and who has been vested with the holy vestments . He shall not uncover his head: he shall not rend his garments.
text_la: Pontifex, id est, sacerdos maximus inter fratres suos, super cujus caput fusum est unctionis oleum, et cujus manus in sacerdotio consecratæ sunt, vestitusque est sanctis vestibus, caput suum non discooperiet, vestimenta non scindet:
text_pt: E o sumo sacerdote entre seus irmãos, sobre cuja cabeça foi derramado o azeite da unção, e que for consagrado para vestir as vestes, não descobrirá a sua cabeça nem rasgará as suas vestes;
text_el: καὶ ὁ ἱερεὺς ὁ μέγας ἀπὸ τῶν ἀδελφῶν αὐτοῦ τοῦ ἐπικεχυμένου ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν τοῦ ἐλαίου τοῦ χριστοῦ καὶ τετελειωμένου ἐνδύσασθαι τὰ ἱμάτια τὴν κεφαλὴν οὐκ ἀποκιδαρώσει καὶ τὰ ἱμάτια οὐ διαρρήξει

text_en: Nor shall he go in at all to any dead person: not even for his father, or his mother, shall he be defiled.
text_la: et ad omnem mortuum non ingredietur omnino: super patre quoque suo et matre non contaminabitur.
text_pt: E não se chegará a cadáver algum, nem por causa de seu pai nem por sua mãe se contaminará;
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ πάσῃ ψυχῇ τετελευτηκυίᾳ οὐκ εἰσελεύσεται ἐπὶ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ οὐδὲ ἐπὶ μητρὶ αὐτοῦ οὐ μιανθήσεται

text_en: Neither shall he go out of the holy places, lest he defile the sanctuary of the Lord : because the oil of the holy unction of his God is upon him. I am the Lord .
text_la: Nec egredietur de sanctis, ne polluat sanctuarium Domini, quia oleum sanctæ unctionis Dei sui super eum est. Ego Dominus.
text_pt: Nem sairá do santuário, para que não profane o santuário do seu Deus, pois a coroa do azeite da unção do seu Deus está sobre ele. Eu sou o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἁγίων οὐκ ἐξελεύσεται καὶ οὐ βεβηλώσει τὸ ἡγιασμένον τοῦ θεοῦ αὐτοῦ ὅτι τὸ ἅγιον ἔλαιον τὸ χριστὸν τοῦ θεοῦ ἐπ' αὐτῷ ἐγὼ κύριος

text_en: He shall take a virgin unto his wife.
text_la: Virginem ducet uxorem:
text_pt: E ele tomará por esposa uma mulher na sua virgindade.
text_el: οὗτος γυναῖκα παρθένον ἐκ τοῦ γένους αὐτοῦ λήμψεται

text_en: But a widow or one that is divorced , or defiled, or a harlot, he shall not take: but a maid of his own people.
text_la: viduam autem et repudiatam, et sordidam, atque meretricem non accipiet, sed puellam de populo suo:
text_pt: Viúva, ou repudiada ou desonrada ou prostituta, estas não tomará; mas virgem do seu povo tomará por mulher.
text_el: χήραν δὲ καὶ ἐκβεβλημένην καὶ βεβηλωμένην καὶ πόρνην ταύτας οὐ λήμψεται ἀλλ' ἢ παρθένον ἐκ τοῦ γένους αὐτοῦ λήμψεται γυναῖκα

text_en: He shall not mingle the stock of his kindred with the common people of this nation: for I am the Lord who sanctify him.
text_la: ne commisceat stirpem generis sui vulgo gentis suæ : quia ego Dominus, qui sanctifico eum.
text_pt: E não profanará a sua descendência entre o seu povo; porque eu sou o Senhor que o santifico.
text_el: καὶ οὐ βεβηλώσει τὸ σπέρμα αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ λαῷ αὐτοῦ ἐγὼ κύριος ὁ ἁγιάζων αὐτόν

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses , saying:
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:
text_pt: Falou mais o Senhor a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: Say to Aaron : Whosoever of your seed throughout their families , has a blemish, he shall not offer bread to his God .
text_la: Loquere ad Aaron : Homo de semine tuo per familias qui habuerit maculam, non offeret panes Deo suo,
text_pt: Fala a Arão, dizendo: Ninguém da tua descendência, nas suas gerações, em que houver algum defeito, se chegará a oferecer o pão do seu Deus.
text_el: εἰπὸν Ααρων ἄνθρωπος ἐκ τοῦ γένους σου εἰς τὰς γενεὰς ὑμῶν τίνι ἐὰν ᾖ ἐν αὐτῷ μῶμος οὐ προσελεύσεται προσφέρειν τὰ δῶρα τοῦ θεοῦ αὐτοῦ

text_en: Neither shall he approach to minister to him: If he be blind; if he be lame; if he have a little, or a great, or a crooked nose;
text_la: nec accedet ad ministerium ejus : si cæcus fuerit, si claudus, si parvo vel grandi, vel torto naso,
text_pt: Pois nenhum homem em quem houver alguma deformidade se chegará; como homem cego, ou coxo, ou de nariz chato, ou de membros demasiadamente compridos,
text_el: πᾶς ἄνθρωπος ᾧ ἂν ᾖ ἐν αὐτῷ μῶμος οὐ προσελεύσεται ἄνθρωπος χωλὸς ἢ τυφλὸς ἢ κολοβόρριν ἢ ὠτότμητος

text_en: if his foot, or if his hand be broken;
text_la: si fracto pede, si manu,
text_pt: Ou homem que tiver quebrado o pé, ou a mão quebrada,
text_el: ἢ ἄνθρωπος ᾧ ἐστιν ἐν αὐτῷ σύντριμμα χειρὸς ἢ σύντριμμα ποδός

text_en: if he be crookbacked; or blear eyed; or have a pearl in his eye, or a continual scab, or a dry scurf in his body, or a rupture.
text_la: si gibbus, si lippus, si albuginem habens in oculo, si jugem scabiem, si impetiginem in corpore, vel herniosus.
text_pt: Ou corcunda, ou anão, ou que tiver defeito no olho, ou sarna, ou impigem, ou que tiver testículo mutilado.
text_el: ἢ κυρτὸς ἢ ἔφηλος ἢ πτίλος τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς ἢ ἄνθρωπος ᾧ ἂν ᾖ ἐν αὐτῷ ψώρα ἀγρία ἢ λιχήν ἢ μόνορχις

text_en: Whosoever of the seed of Aaron the priest has a blemish: he shall not approach to offer sacrifices to the Lord , nor bread to his God .
text_la: Omnis qui habuerit maculam de semine Aaron sacerdotis, non accedet offerre hostias Domino, nec panes Deo suo:
text_pt: Nenhum homem da descendência de Arão, o sacerdote, em quem houver alguma deformidade, se chegará para oferecer as ofertas queimadas do Senhor; defeito nele há; não se chegará para oferecer o pão do seu Deus.
text_el: πᾶς ᾧ ἐστιν ἐν αὐτῷ μῶμος ἐκ τοῦ σπέρματος Ααρων τοῦ ἱερέως οὐκ ἐγγιεῖ τοῦ προσενεγκεῖν τὰς θυσίας τῷ θεῷ σου ὅτι μῶμος ἐν αὐτῷ τὰ δῶρα τοῦ θεοῦ οὐ προσελεύσεται προσενεγκεῖν

text_en: He shall eat nevertheless of the loaves that are offered in the sanctuary.
text_la: vescetur tamen panibus qui offeruntur in sanctuario,
text_pt: Ele comerá do pão do seu Deus, tanto do santíssimo como do santo.
text_el: τὰ δῶρα τοῦ θεοῦ τὰ ἅγια τῶν ἁγίων καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν ἁγίων φάγεται

text_en: Yet so that he enter not within the veil, nor approach to the altar : because he has a blemish, and he must not defile my sanctuary. I am the Lord who sanctify them.
text_la: ita dumtaxat, ut intra velum non ingrediatur, nec accedat ad altare, quia maculam habet, et contaminare non debet sanctuarium meum. Ego Dominus qui sanctifico eos.
text_pt: Porém até ao véu não entrará, nem se chegará ao altar, porquanto defeito há nele, para que não profane os meus santuários; porque eu sou o Senhor que os santifico.
text_el: πλὴν πρὸς τὸ καταπέτασμα οὐ προσελεύσεται καὶ πρὸς τὸ θυσιαστήριον οὐκ ἐγγιεῖ ὅτι μῶμον ἔχει καὶ οὐ βεβηλώσει τὸ ἅγιον τοῦ θεοῦ αὐτοῦ ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι κύριος ὁ ἁγιάζων αὐτούς

text_en: Moses , therefore spoke to Aaron , and to his sons and to all Israel , all the things that had been commanded him.
text_la: Locutus est ergo Moyses ad Aaron, et ad filios ejus, et ad omnem Israël cuncta quæ fuerant sibi imperata.
text_pt: E Moisés falou isto a Arão e a seus filhos, e a todos os filhos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν Μωυσῆς πρὸς Ααρων καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ καὶ πρὸς πάντας υἱοὺς Ισραηλ

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses saying:
text_la: Locutus quoque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:
text_pt: Depois falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: Speak to Aaron and to his sons, that they beware of those things that are consecrated of the children of Israel : and defile not the name of the things sanctified to me, which they offer. I am the Lord .
text_la: Loquere ad Aaron et ad filios ejus, ut caveant ab his quæ consecrata sunt filiorum Israël, et non contaminent nomen sanctificatorum mihi, quæ ipsi offerunt. Ego Dominus.
text_pt: Dize a Arão e a seus filhos que se apartem das coisas santas dos filhos de Israel, que a mim me santificam, para que não profanem o meu santo nome. Eu sou o Senhor.
text_el: εἰπὸν Ααρων καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτοῦ καὶ προσεχέτωσαν ἀπὸ τῶν ἁγίων τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ καὶ οὐ βεβηλώσουσιν τὸ ὄνομα τὸ ἅγιόν μου ὅσα αὐτοὶ ἁγιάζουσίν μοι ἐγὼ κύριος

text_en: Say to them and to their posterity: Every man of your race, that approaches to those things that are consecrated , and which the children of Israel have offered to the Lord , in whom there is uncleanness , shall perish before the Lord . I am the Lord .
text_la: Dic ad eos, et ad posteros eorum : Omnis homo qui accesserit de stirpe vestra ad ea quæ consecrata sunt, et quæ obtulerunt filii Israël Domino, in quo est immunditia, peribit coram Domino. Ego sum Dominus.
text_pt: Dize-lhes: Todo o homem, que entre as vossas gerações, de toda a vossa descendência, se chegar às coisas santas que os filhos de Israel santificam ao Senhor, tendo sobre si a sua imundícia, aquela alma será extirpada de diante da minha face. Eu sou o Senhor.
text_el: εἰπὸν αὐτοῖς εἰς τὰς γενεὰς ὑμῶν πᾶς ἄνθρωπος ὃς ἂν προσέλθῃ ἀπὸ παντὸς τοῦ σπέρματος ὑμῶν πρὸς τὰ ἅγια ὅσα ἂν ἁγιάζωσιν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ ἡ ἀκαθαρσία αὐτοῦ ἐπ' αὐτῷ ἐξολεθρευθήσεται ἡ ψυχὴ ἐκείνη ἀπ' ἐμοῦ ἐγὼ κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν

text_en: The man of the seed of Aaron , that is a leper , or that suffers a running of the seed, shall not eat of those things that are sanctified to me, until he be healed. He that touches anything unclean by occasion of the dead: and he whose seed goes from him as in generation :
text_la: Homo de semine Aaron, qui fuerit leprosus, aut patiens fluxum seminis, non vescetur de his quæ sanctificata sunt mihi, donec sanetur. Qui tetigerit immundum super mortuo, et ex quo egreditur semen quasi coitus,
text_pt: Ninguém da descendência de Arão, que for leproso, ou tiver fluxo, comerá das coisas santas, até que seja limpo; como também o que tocar alguma coisa imunda de cadáver, ou aquele de que sair sêmen da cópula,
text_el: καὶ ἄνθρωπος ἐκ τοῦ σπέρματος Ααρων τοῦ ἱερέως καὶ οὗτος λεπρᾷ ἢ γονορρυής τῶν ἁγίων οὐκ ἔδεται ἕως ἂν καθαρισθῇ καὶ ὁ ἁπτόμενος πάσης ἀκαθαρσίας ψυχῆς ἢ ἄνθρωπος ᾧ ἂν ἐξέλθῃ ἐξ αὐτοῦ κοίτη σπέρματος

text_en: And he that touches a creeping thing, or any unclean thing, the touching of which is defiling:
text_la: et qui tangit reptile, et quodlibet immundum cujus tactus est sordidus,
text_pt: Ou qualquer que tocar a algum réptil, pelo qual se fez imundo, ou a algum homem, pelo qual se fez imundo, segundo toda a sua imundícia;
text_el: ἢ ὅστις ἂν ἅψηται παντὸς ἑρπετοῦ ἀκαθάρτου ὃ μιανεῖ αὐτόν ἢ ἐπ' ἀνθρώπῳ ἐν ᾧ μιανεῖ αὐτὸν κατὰ πᾶσαν ἀκαθαρσίαν αὐτοῦ

text_en: Shall be unclean until the evening, and shall not eat those things that are sanctified . But when he has washed his flesh with water,
text_la: immundus erit usque ad vesperum, et non vescetur his quæ sanctificata sunt : sed cum laverit carnem suam aqua,
text_pt: O homem que o tocar será imundo até à tarde, e não comerá das coisas santas, mas banhará a sua carne em água.
text_el: ψυχή ἥτις ἂν ἅψηται αὐτῶν ἀκάθαρτος ἔσται ἕως ἑσπέρας οὐκ ἔδεται ἀπὸ τῶν ἁγίων ἐὰν μὴ λούσηται τὸ σῶμα αὐτοῦ ὕδατι

text_en: and the sun is down, then being purified, he shall eat of the sanctified things, because it is his meat.
text_la: et occubuerit sol, tunc mundatus vescetur de sanctificatis, quia cibus illius est.
text_pt: E havendo-se o sol já posto, então será limpo, e depois comerá das coisas santas; porque este é o seu pão.
text_el: καὶ δύῃ ὁ ἥλιος καὶ καθαρὸς ἔσται καὶ τότε φάγεται τῶν ἁγίων ὅτι ἄρτος ἐστὶν αὐτοῦ

text_en: That which dies of itself, and that which was taken by a beast, they shall not eat, nor be defiled therewith. I am the Lord .
text_la: Morticinum et captum a bestia non comedent, nec polluentur in eis. Ego sum Dominus.
text_pt: O corpo morto e o dilacerado não comerá, para que não se contamine com ele. Eu sou o Senhor.
text_el: θνησιμαῖον καὶ θηριάλωτον οὐ φάγεται μιανθῆναι αὐτὸν ἐν αὐτοῖς ἐγὼ κύριος

text_en: Let them keep my precepts , that they may not fall into sin , and die in the sanctuary, when they shall have defiled it. I am the Lord who sanctify them.
text_la: Custodiant præcepta mea, ut non subjaceant peccato, et moriantur in sanctuario, cum polluerint illud. Ego Dominus qui sanctifico eos.
text_pt: Guardarão, pois, o meu mandamento, para que por isso não levem pecado, e morram nele, havendo-o profanado. Eu sou o Senhor que os santifico.
text_el: καὶ φυλάξονται τὰ φυλάγματά μου ἵνα μὴ λάβωσιν δι' αὐτὰ ἁμαρτίαν καὶ ἀποθάνωσιν δι' αὐτά ἐὰν βεβηλώσωσιν αὐτά ἐγὼ κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὁ ἁγιάζων αὐτούς

text_en: No stranger shall eat of the sanctified things: a sojourner of the priests , or a hired servant, shall not eat of them.
text_la: Omnis alienigena non comedet de sanctificatis; inquilinus sacerdotis et mercenarius non vescentur ex eis.
text_pt: Também nenhum estranho comerá das coisas santas; nem o hóspede do sacerdote, nem o diarista comerá das coisas santas.
text_el: καὶ πᾶς ἀλλογενὴς οὐ φάγεται ἅγια πάροικος ἱερέως ἢ μισθωτὸς οὐ φάγεται ἅγια

text_en: But he whom the priest has bought, and he that is his servant, born in his house, these shall eat of them.
text_la: Quem autem sacerdos emerit, et qui vernaculus domus ejus fuerit, his comedent ex eis.
text_pt: Mas quando o sacerdote comprar alguma pessoa com o seu dinheiro, aquela comerá delas, e os nascidos na sua casa, estes comerão do seu pão.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἱερεὺς κτήσηται ψυχὴν ἔγκτητον ἀργυρίου οὗτος φάγεται ἐκ τῶν ἄρτων αὐτοῦ καὶ οἱ οἰκογενεῖς αὐτοῦ καὶ οὗτοι φάγονται τῶν ἄρτων αὐτοῦ

text_en: If the daughter of a priest be married to any of the people, she shall not eat of those things that are sanctified nor of the firstfruits .
text_la: Si filia sacerdotis cuilibet ex populo nupta fuerit, de his quæ sanctificata sunt, et de primitiis non vescetur.
text_pt: E, quando a filha do sacerdote se casar com homem estranho, ela não comerá da oferta das coisas santas.
text_el: καὶ θυγάτηρ ἀνθρώπου ἱερέως ἐὰν γένηται ἀνδρὶ ἀλλογενεῖ αὐτὴ τῶν ἀπαρχῶν τῶν ἁγίων οὐ φάγεται

text_en: But if she be a widow , or divorced , and having no children return to her father's house, she shall eat of her father's meats, as she was wont to do when she was a maid. No stranger has leave to eat of them.
text_la: Sin autem vidua, vel repudiata, et absque liberis reversa fuerit ad domum patris sui : sicut puella consueverat, aletur cibis patris sui. Omnis alienigena comedendi ex eis non habet potestatem.
text_pt: Mas quando a filha do sacerdote for viúva ou repudiada, e não tiver filho, e se houver tornado à casa de seu pai, como na sua mocidade, do pão de seu pai comerá; mas nenhum estranho comerá dele.
text_el: καὶ θυγάτηρ ἱερέως ἐὰν γένηται χήρα ἢ ἐκβεβλημένη σπέρμα δὲ μὴ ἦν αὐτῇ ἐπαναστρέψει ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον τὸν πατρικὸν κατὰ τὴν νεότητα αὐτῆς ἀπὸ τῶν ἄρτων τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτῆς φάγεται καὶ πᾶς ἀλλογενὴς οὐ φάγεται ἀπ' αὐτῶν

text_en: He that eats of the sanctified things through ignorance , shall add the fifth part with that which he ate, and shall give it to the priest into the sanctuary.
text_la: Qui comederit de sanctificatis per ignorantiam, addet quintam partem cum eo quod comedit, et dabit sacerdoti in sanctuarium.
text_pt: E quando alguém por erro comer a coisa santa, sobre ela acrescentará uma quinta parte, e a dará ao sacerdote com a coisa santa.
text_el: καὶ ἄνθρωπος ὃς ἂν φάγῃ ἅγια κατὰ ἄγνοιαν καὶ προσθήσει τὸ ἐπίπεμπτον αὐτοῦ ἐπ' αὐτὸ καὶ δώσει τῷ ἱερεῖ τὸ ἅγιον

text_en: And they shall not profane the sanctified things of the children of Israel , which they offer to the Lord :
text_la: Nec contaminabunt sanctificata filiorum Israël, quæ offerunt Domino:
text_pt: Assim não profanarão as coisas santas dos filhos de Israel, que oferecem ao Senhor,
text_el: καὶ οὐ βεβηλώσουσιν τὰ ἅγια τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἃ αὐτοὶ ἀφαιροῦσιν τῷ κυρίῳ

text_en: Lest perhaps they bear the iniquity of their trespass , when they shall have eaten the sanctified things. I am the Lord who sanctify them.
text_la: ne forte sustineant iniquitatem delicti sui, cum sanctificata comederint. Ego Dominus qui sanctifico eos.
text_pt: Nem os farão levar a iniqüidade da culpa, comendo as suas coisas santas; pois eu sou o Senhor que as santifico.
text_el: καὶ ἐπάξουσιν ἐφ' ἑαυτοὺς ἀνομίαν πλημμελείας ἐν τῷ ἐσθίειν αὐτοὺς τὰ ἅγια αὐτῶν ὅτι ἐγὼ κύριος ὁ ἁγιάζων αὐτούς

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses , saying:
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:
text_pt: Falou mais o Senhor a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: Speak to Aaron , and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel , and you shall say to them: The man of the house of Israel , and of the strangers who dwell with you, that offers his oblation , either paying his vows , or offering of his own accord, whatsoever it be which he presents for a holocaust of the Lord ,
text_la: Loquere ad Aaron et filios ejus, et ad omnes filios Israël, dicesque ad eos : Homo de domo Israël, et de advenis qui habitant apud vos, qui obtulerit oblationem suam, vel vota solvens, vel sponte offerens, quidquid illud obtulerit in holocaustum Domini,
text_pt: Fala a Arão, e a seus filhos, e a todos os filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Qualquer que, da casa de Israel, ou dos estrangeiros em Israel, oferecer a sua oferta, quer dos seus votos, quer das suas ofertas voluntárias, que oferecem ao Senhor em holocausto,
text_el: λάλησον Ααρων καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτοῦ καὶ πάσῃ συναγωγῇ Ισραηλ καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτούς ἄνθρωπος ἄνθρωπος ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἢ τῶν υἱῶν τῶν προσηλύτων τῶν προσκειμένων πρὸς αὐτοὺς ἐν Ισραηλ ὃς ἂν προσενέγκῃ τὰ δῶρα αὐτοῦ κατὰ πᾶσαν ὁμολογίαν αὐτῶν ἢ κατὰ πᾶσαν αἵρεσιν αὐτῶν ὅσα ἂν προσενέγκωσιν τῷ θεῷ εἰς ὁλοκαύτωμα

text_en: to be offered by you: it shall be a male without blemish of the beeves, or of the sheep, or of the goats.
text_la: ut offeratur per vos, masculus immaculatus erit ex bobus, et ovibus, et ex capris:
text_pt: Segundo a sua vontade, oferecerá macho sem defeito, ou dos bois, ou dos cordeiros, ou das cabras.
text_el: δεκτὰ ὑμῖν ἄμωμα ἄρσενα ἐκ τῶν βουκολίων καὶ ἐκ τῶν προβάτων καὶ ἐκ τῶν αἰγῶν

text_en: If it have a blemish you shall not offer it: neither shall it be acceptable.
text_la: si maculam habuerit, non offeretis, neque erit acceptabile.
text_pt: Nenhuma coisa em que haja defeito oferecereis, porque não seria aceita em vosso favor.
text_el: πάντα ὅσα ἂν ἔχῃ μῶμον ἐν αὐτῷ οὐ προσάξουσιν κυρίῳ διότι οὐ δεκτὸν ἔσται ὑμῖν

text_en: The man that offers a victim of peace offerings to the Lord , either paying his vows , or offering of his own accord, whether of beeves or of sheep, shall offer it without blemish, that it may be acceptable. There shall be no blemish in it.
text_la: Homo qui obtulerit victimam pacificorum Domino, vel vota solvens, vel sponte offerens, tam de bobus quam de ovibus, immaculatum offeret ut acceptabile sit : omnis macula non erit in eo.
text_pt: E, quando alguém oferecer sacrifício pacífico ao Senhor, separando dos bois ou das ovelhas um voto, ou oferta voluntária, sem defeito será, para que seja aceito; nenhum defeito haverá nele.
text_el: καὶ ἄνθρωπος ὃς ἂν προσενέγκῃ θυσίαν σωτηρίου τῷ κυρίῳ διαστείλας εὐχὴν κατὰ αἵρεσιν ἢ ἐν ταῖς ἑορταῖς ὑμῶν ἐκ τῶν βουκολίων ἢ ἐκ τῶν προβάτων ἄμωμον ἔσται εἰς δεκτόν πᾶς μῶμος οὐκ ἔσται ἐν αὐτῷ

text_en: If it be blind, or broken, or have a scar or blisters, or a scab, or a dry scurf: you shall not offer them to the Lord , nor burn anything of them upon the Lord's altar .
text_la: Si cæcum fuerit, si fractum, si cicatricem habens, si papulas, aut scabiem, aut impetiginem : non offeretis ea Domino, nec adolebitis ex eis super altare Domini.
text_pt: O cego, ou quebrado, ou aleijado, o verrugoso, ou sarnoso, ou cheio de impigens, estes não oferecereis ao Senhor, e deles não poreis oferta queimada ao Senhor sobre o altar.
text_el: τυφλὸν ἢ συντετριμμένον ἢ γλωσσότμητον ἢ μυρμηκιῶντα ἢ ψωραγριῶντα ἢ λιχῆνας ἔχοντα οὐ προσάξουσιν ταῦτα τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ εἰς κάρπωσιν οὐ δώσετε ἀπ' αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον τῷ κυρίῳ

text_en: An ox or a sheep, that has the ear and the tail cut off, you may offer voluntarily: but a vow may not be paid with them.
text_la: Bovem et ovem, aure et cauda amputatis, voluntarie offerre potes, votum autem ex eis solvi non potest.
text_pt: Porém boi, ou gado miúdo, comprido ou curto de membros, poderás oferecer por oferta voluntária, mas por voto não será aceito.
text_el: καὶ μόσχον ἢ πρόβατον ὠτότμητον ἢ κολοβόκερκον σφάγια ποιήσεις αὐτὰ σεαυτῷ εἰς δὲ εὐχήν σου οὐ δεχθήσεται

text_en: You shall not offer to the Lord any beast that has the testicles bruised, or crushed, or cut and taken away: neither shall you do any such things in your land.
text_la: Omne animal, quod vel contritis, vel tusis, vel sectis ablatisque testiculis est, non offeretis Domino, et in terra vestra hoc omnino ne faciatis.
text_pt: O machucado, ou moído, ou despedaçado, ou cortado, não oferecereis ao Senhor; não fareis isto na vossa terra.
text_el: θλαδίαν καὶ ἐκτεθλιμμένον καὶ ἐκτομίαν καὶ ἀπεσπασμένον οὐ προσάξεις αὐτὰ τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ὑμῶν οὐ ποιήσετε

text_en: You shall not offer bread to your God , from the hand of a stranger, nor any other thing that he would give: because they are all corrupted, and defiled. You shall not receive them.
text_la: De manu alienigenæ non offeretis panes Deo vestro, et quidquid aliud dare voluerit, quia corrupta, et maculata sunt omnia : non suscipietis ea.
text_pt: Também da mão do estrangeiro nenhum alimento oferecereis ao vosso Deus, de todas estas coisas, pois a sua corrupção está nelas; defeito nelas há; não serão aceitas em vosso favor.
text_el: καὶ ἐκ χειρὸς ἀλλογενοῦς οὐ προσοίσετε τὰ δῶρα τοῦ θεοῦ ὑμῶν ἀπὸ πάντων τούτων ὅτι φθάρματά ἐστιν ἐν αὐτοῖς μῶμος ἐν αὐτοῖς οὐ δεχθήσεται ταῦτα ὑμῖν

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses , saying:
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:
text_pt: Falou mais o Senhor a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: When a bullock, or a sheep, or a goat, is brought forth, they shall be seven days under the udder of their dam: but the eighth day, and thenceforth, they may be offered to the Lord .
text_la: Bos, ovis et capra, cum genita fuerint, septem diebus erunt sub ubere matris suæ : die autem octavo, et deinceps, offerri poterunt Domino.
text_pt: Quando nascer o boi, ou cordeiro, ou cabra, sete dias estará debaixo de sua mãe; depois, desde o oitavo dia em diante, será aceito por oferta queimada ao Senhor.
text_el: μόσχον ἢ πρόβατον ἢ αἶγα ὡς ἂν τεχθῇ καὶ ἔσται ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας ὑπὸ τὴν μητέρα τῇ δὲ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ὀγδόῃ καὶ ἐπέκεινα δεχθήσεται εἰς δῶρα κάρπωμα κυρίῳ

text_en: Whether it be a cow, or a sheep, they shall not be sacrificed the same day with their young ones.
text_la: Sive illa bos, sive ovis, non immolabuntur una die cum fœtibus suis.
text_pt: Também boi ou gado miúdo, a ele e a seu filho não degolareis no mesmo dia.
text_el: καὶ μόσχον ἢ πρόβατον αὐτὴν καὶ τὰ παιδία αὐτῆς οὐ σφάξεις ἐν ἡμέρᾳ μιᾷ

text_en: If you immolate a victim for thanksgiving to the Lord , that he may be favourable,
text_la: Si immolaveritis hostiam pro gratiarum actione Domino, ut possit esse placabilis,
text_pt: E, quando oferecerdes sacrifícios de louvores ao Senhor, o oferecereis da vossa vontade.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ θύσῃς θυσίαν εὐχὴν χαρμοσύνης κυρίῳ εἰς δεκτὸν ὑμῖν θύσετε αὐτό

text_en: you shall eat it the same day. There shall not any of it remain until the morning of the next day. I am the Lord .
text_la: eodem die comedetis eam : non remanebit quidquam in mane alterius diei. Ego Dominus.
text_pt: No mesmo dia se comerá; dele nada deixareis ficar até pela manhã. Eu sou o Senhor.
text_el: αὐτῇ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ βρωθήσεται οὐκ ἀπολείψετε ἀπὸ τῶν κρεῶν εἰς τὸ πρωί ἐγώ εἰμι κύριος

text_en: Keep my commandments , and do them. I am the Lord .
text_la: Custodite mandata mea, et facite ea. Ego Dominus.
text_pt: Por isso guardareis os meus mandamentos, e os cumprireis. Eu sou o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ φυλάξετε τὰς ἐντολάς μου καὶ ποιήσετε αὐτάς

text_en: Profane not my holy name , that I may be sanctified in the midst of the children of Israel . I am the Lord who sanctify you:
text_la: Ne polluatis nomen meum sanctum, ut sanctificer in medio filiorum Israël. Ego Dominus qui sanctifico vos,
text_pt: E não profanareis o meu santo nome, para que eu seja santificado no meio dos filhos de Israel. Eu sou o Senhor que vos santifico;
text_el: καὶ οὐ βεβηλώσετε τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ ἁγίου καὶ ἁγιασθήσομαι ἐν μέσῳ τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἐγὼ κύριος ὁ ἁγιάζων ὑμᾶς

text_en: And who brought you out of the land of Egypt , that I might be your God . I am the Lord .
text_la: et eduxi de terra Ægypti, ut essem vobis in Deum. Ego Dominus.
text_pt: Que vos tirei da terra do Egito, para ser o vosso Deus. Eu sou o Senhor.
text_el: ὁ ἐξαγαγὼν ὑμᾶς ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου ὥστε εἶναι ὑμῶν θεός ἐγὼ κύριος

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses , saying:
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:
text_pt: Depois falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: Speak to the children of Israel , and you shall say to them: These are the feasts of the Lord , which you shall call holy .
text_la: Loquere filiis Israël, et dices ad eos : Hæ sunt feriæ Domini, quas vocabitis sanctas.
text_pt: Fala aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: As solenidades do Senhor, que convocareis, serão santas convocações; estas são as minhas solenidades:
text_el: λάλησον τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτούς αἱ ἑορταὶ κυρίου ἃς καλέσετε αὐτὰς κλητὰς ἁγίας αὗταί εἰσιν ἑορταί μου

text_en: Six days shall you do work: the seventh day, because it is the rest of the sabbath , shall be called holy . You shall do no work on that day: it is the sabbath of the Lord in all your habitations.
text_la: Sex diebus facietis opus : dies septimus, quia sabbati requies est, vocabitur sanctus : omne opus non facietis in eo : sabbatum Domini est in cunctis habitationibus vestris.
text_pt: Seis dias trabalho se fará, mas o sétimo dia será o sábado do descanso, santa convocação; nenhum trabalho fareis; sábado do Senhor é em todas as vossas habitações.
text_el: ἓξ ἡμέρας ποιήσεις ἔργα καὶ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἑβδόμῃ σάββατα ἀνάπαυσις κλητὴ ἁγία τῷ κυρίῳ πᾶν ἔργον οὐ ποιήσεις σάββατά ἐστιν τῷ κυρίῳ ἐν πάσῃ κατοικίᾳ ὑμῶν

text_en: These also are the holy days of the Lord , which you must celebrate in their seasons.
text_la: Hæ sunt ergo feriæ Domini sanctæ, quas celebrare debetis temporibus suis.
text_pt: Estas são as solenidades do Senhor, as santas convocações, que convocareis ao seu tempo determinado:
text_el: αὗται αἱ ἑορταὶ τῷ κυρίῳ κληταὶ ἅγιαι ἃς καλέσετε αὐτὰς ἐν τοῖς καιροῖς αὐτῶν

text_en: The first month, the fourteenth day of the month at evening, is the phase of the Lord .
text_la: Mense primo, quartadecima die mensis ad vesperum, Phase Domini est:
text_pt: No mês primeiro, aos catorze do mês, pela tarde, é a páscoa do Senhor.
text_el: ἐν τῷ πρώτῳ μηνὶ ἐν τῇ τεσσαρεσκαιδεκάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ μηνὸς ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν ἑσπερινῶν πάσχα τῷ κυρίῳ

text_en: And the fifteenth day of the same month is the solemnity of the unleavened bread of the Lord . Seven days shall you eat unleavened bread .
text_la: et quintadecima die mensis hujus, solemnitas azymorum Domini est. Septem diebus azyma comedetis.
text_pt: E aos quinze dias deste mês é a festa dos pães ázimos do Senhor; sete dias comereis pães ázimos.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τῇ πεντεκαιδεκάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ μηνὸς τούτου ἑορτὴ τῶν ἀζύμων τῷ κυρίῳ ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας ἄζυμα ἔδεσθε

text_en: The first day shall be most solemn unto you, and holy : you shall do no servile work therein.
text_la: Dies primus erit vobis celeberrimus, sanctusque : omne opus servile non facietis in eo,
text_pt: No primeiro dia tereis santa convocação; nenhum trabalho servil fareis;
text_el: καὶ ἡ ἡμέρα ἡ πρώτη κλητὴ ἁγία ἔσται ὑμῖν πᾶν ἔργον λατρευτὸν οὐ ποιήσετε

text_en: But you shall offer sacrifice in fire to the Lord seven days. And the seventh day shall be more solemn, and more holy : and you shall do no servile work therein.
text_la: sed offeretis sacrificium in igne Domino septem diebus. Dies autem septimus erit celebrior et sanctior : nullumque servile opus facietis in eo.
text_pt: Mas sete dias oferecereis oferta queimada ao Senhor; ao sétimo dia haverá santa convocação; nenhum trabalho servil fareis.
text_el: καὶ προσάξετε ὁλοκαυτώματα τῷ κυρίῳ ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας καὶ ἡ ἑβδόμη ἡμέρα κλητὴ ἁγία ἔσται ὑμῖν πᾶν ἔργον λατρευτὸν οὐ ποιήσετε

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses , saying:
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:
text_pt: E falou o Senhor a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: Speak to the children of Israel , and you shall say to them: When you shall have entered into the land which I will give you, and shall reap your corn, you shall bring sheaves of ears, the firstfruits of your harvest to the priest .
text_la: Loquere filiis Israël, et dices ad eos : Cum ingressi fueritis terram, quam ego dabo vobis, et messueritis segetem, feretis manipulos spicarum, primitias messis vestræ, ad sacerdotem:
text_pt: Fala aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Quando houverdes entrado na terra, que vos hei de dar, e fizerdes a sua colheita, então trareis um molho das primícias da vossa sega ao sacerdote;
text_el: εἰπὸν τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτούς ὅταν εἰσέλθητε εἰς τὴν γῆν ἣν ἐγὼ δίδωμι ὑμῖν καὶ θερίζητε τὸν θερισμὸν αὐτῆς καὶ οἴσετε δράγμα ἀπαρχὴν τοῦ θερισμοῦ ὑμῶν πρὸς τὸν ἱερέα

text_en: Who shall lift up the sheaf before the Lord , the next day after the sabbath , that it may be acceptable for you, and shall sanctify it.
text_la: qui elevabit fasciculum coram Domino, ut acceptabile sit pro vobis, altero die sabbati, et sanctificabit illum.
text_pt: E ele moverá o molho perante o Senhor, para que sejais aceitos; no dia seguinte ao sábado o sacerdote o moverá.
text_el: καὶ ἀνοίσει τὸ δράγμα ἔναντι κυρίου δεκτὸν ὑμῖν τῇ ἐπαύριον τῆς πρώτης ἀνοίσει αὐτὸ ὁ ἱερεύς

text_en: And on the same day that the sheaf is consecrated , a lamb without blemish of the first year shall be killed for a holocaust of the Lord .
text_la: Atque in eodem die quo manipulus consecratur, cædetur agnus immaculatus anniculus in holocaustum Domini.
text_pt: E no dia em que moverdes o molho, preparareis um cordeiro sem defeito, de um ano, em holocausto ao Senhor,
text_el: καὶ ποιήσετε ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐν ᾗ ἂν φέρητε τὸ δράγμα πρόβατον ἄμωμον ἐνιαύσιον εἰς ὁλοκαύτωμα τῷ κυρίῳ

text_en: And the libations shall be offered with it: two tenths of flour tempered with oil, for a burnt offering of the Lord , and a most sweet odour. Libations also of wine, the fourth part of a hin.
text_la: Et libamenta offerentur cum eo, duæ decimæ similæ conspersæ oleo in incensum Domini, odoremque suavissimum : liba quoque vini, quarta pars hin.
text_pt: E a sua oferta de alimentos, será de duas dízimas de flor de farinha, amassada com azeite, para oferta queimada em cheiro suave ao Senhor, e a sua libação será de vinho, um quarto de him.
text_el: καὶ τὴν θυσίαν αὐτοῦ δύο δέκατα σεμιδάλεως ἀναπεποιημένης ἐν ἐλαίῳ θυσία τῷ κυρίῳ ὀσμὴ εὐωδίας κυρίῳ καὶ σπονδὴν αὐτοῦ τὸ τέταρτον τοῦ ιν οἴνου

text_en: You shall not eat either bread, or parched corn, or frumenty or the harvest, until the day that you shall offer thereof to your God . It is a precept for ever throughout your generations , and all your dwellings.
text_la: Panem, et polentam, et pultes non comedetis ex segete, usque ad diem qua offeretis ex ea Deo vestro. Præceptum est sempiternum in generationibus, cunctisque habitaculis vestris.
text_pt: E não comereis pão, nem trigo tostado, nem espigas verdes, até aquele mesmo dia em que trouxerdes a oferta do vosso Deus; estatuto perpétuo é por vossas gerações, em todas as vossas habitações.
text_el: καὶ ἄρτον καὶ πεφρυγμένα χίδρα νέα οὐ φάγεσθε ἕως εἰς αὐτὴν τὴν ἡμέραν ταύτην ἕως ἂν προσενέγκητε ὑμεῖς τὰ δῶρα τῷ θεῷ ὑμῶν νόμιμον αἰώνιον εἰς τὰς γενεὰς ὑμῶν ἐν πάσῃ κατοικίᾳ ὑμῶν

text_en: You shall count therefore from the morrow after the sabbath , wherein you offered the sheaf of firstfruits , seven full weeks.
text_la: Numerabitis ergo ab altero die sabbati, in quo obtulistis manipulum primitiarum, septem hebdomadas plenas,
text_pt: Depois para vós contareis desde o dia seguinte ao sábado, desde o dia em que trouxerdes o molho da oferta movida; sete semanas inteiras serão.
text_el: καὶ ἀριθμήσετε ὑμεῖς ἀπὸ τῆς ἐπαύριον τῶν σαββάτων ἀπὸ τῆς ἡμέρας ἧς ἂν προσενέγκητε τὸ δράγμα τοῦ ἐπιθέματος ἑπτὰ ἑβδομάδας ὁλοκλήρους

text_en: Even unto the morrow after the seventh week be expired, that is to say, fifty days: and so you shall offer a new sacrifice to the Lord .
text_la: usque ad alteram diem expletionis hebdomadæ septimæ, id est, quinquaginta dies : et sic offeretis sacrificium novum Domino
text_pt: Até ao dia seguinte ao sétimo sábado, contareis cinqüenta dias; então oferecereis nova oferta de alimentos ao Senhor.
text_el: ἕως τῆς ἐπαύριον τῆς ἐσχάτης ἑβδομάδος ἀριθμήσετε πεντήκοντα ἡμέρας καὶ προσοίσετε θυσίαν νέαν τῷ κυρίῳ

text_en: Out of all your dwellings, two loaves of the firstfruits , of two tenths of flour leavened, which you shall bake for the firstfruits of the Lord .
text_la: ex omnibus habitaculis vestris, panes primitiarum duos de duabus decimis similæ fermentatæ, quos coquetis in primitias Domini.
text_pt: Das vossas habitações trareis dois pães de movimento; de duas dízimas de farinha serão, levedados se cozerão; primícias são ao Senhor.
text_el: ἀπὸ τῆς κατοικίας ὑμῶν προσοίσετε ἄρτους ἐπίθεμα δύο ἄρτους ἐκ δύο δεκάτων σεμιδάλεως ἔσονται ἐζυμωμένοι πεφθήσονται πρωτογενημάτων τῷ κυρίῳ

text_en: And you shall offer with the loaves seven lambs without blemish of the first year, and one calf from the herd, and they shall be for a holocaust with their two rams: and they shall be for a holocaust with their libations for a most sweet odour to the Lord .
text_la: Offeretisque cum panibus septem agnos immaculatos anniculos, et vitulum de armento unum, et arietes duos, et erunt in holocaustum cum libamentis suis, in odorem suavissimum Domini.
text_pt: Também com o pão oferecereis sete cordeiros sem defeito, de um ano, e um novilho, e dois carneiros; holocausto serão ao Senhor, com a sua oferta de alimentos, e as suas libações, por oferta queimada de cheiro suave ao Senhor.
text_el: καὶ προσάξετε μετὰ τῶν ἄρτων ἑπτὰ ἀμνοὺς ἀμώμους ἐνιαυσίους καὶ μόσχον ἕνα ἐκ βουκολίου καὶ κριοὺς δύο ἀμώμους ἔσονται ὁλοκαύτωμα τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ αἱ θυσίαι αὐτῶν καὶ αἱ σπονδαὶ αὐτῶν θυσίαν ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας τῷ κυρίῳ

text_en: You shall offer also a buck goat for sin , and two lambs of the first year for sacrifices of peace offerings .
text_la: Facietis et hircum pro peccato, duosque agnos anniculos hostias pacificorum.
text_pt: Também oferecereis um bode para expiação do pecado, e dois cordeiros de um ano por sacrifício pacífico.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσουσιν χίμαρον ἐξ αἰγῶν ἕνα περὶ ἁμαρτίας καὶ δύο ἀμνοὺς ἐνιαυσίους εἰς θυσίαν σωτηρίου μετὰ τῶν ἄρτων τοῦ πρωτογενήματος

text_en: And when the priest has lifted them up with the loaves of the firstfruits before the Lord , they shall fall to his use.
text_la: Cumque elevaverit eos sacerdos cum panibus primitiarum coram Domino, cedent in usum ejus.
text_pt: Então o sacerdote os moverá com o pão das primícias por oferta movida perante o Senhor, com os dois cordeiros; santos serão ao Senhor para uso do sacerdote.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιθήσει αὐτὰ ὁ ἱερεὺς μετὰ τῶν ἄρτων τοῦ πρωτογενήματος ἐπίθεμα ἔναντι κυρίου μετὰ τῶν δύο ἀμνῶν ἅγια ἔσονται τῷ κυρίῳ τῷ ἱερεῖ τῷ προσφέροντι αὐτὰ αὐτῷ ἔσται

text_en: And you shall call this day most solemn , and most holy . You shall do no servile work therein. It shall be an everlasting ordinance in all your dwellings and generations .
text_la: Et vocabitis hunc diem celeberrimum, atque sanctissimum : omne opus servile non facietis in eo. Legitimum sempiternum erit in cunctis habitaculis, et generationibus vestris.
text_pt: E naquele mesmo dia apregoareis que tereis santa convocação; nenhum trabalho servil fareis; estatuto perpétuo é em todas as vossas habitações pelas vossas gerações.
text_el: καὶ καλέσετε ταύτην τὴν ἡμέραν κλητήν ἁγία ἔσται ὑμῖν πᾶν ἔργον λατρευτὸν οὐ ποιήσετε ἐν αὐτῇ νόμιμον αἰώνιον εἰς τὰς γενεὰς ὑμῶν ἐν πάσῃ τῇ κατοικίᾳ ὑμῶν

text_en: And when you reap the corn of your land, you shall not cut it to the very ground: neither shall you gather the ears that remain. But you shall leave them for the poor and for the strangers. I am the Lord your God .
text_la: Postquam autem messueritis segetem terræ vestræ, nec secabitis eam usque ad solum, nec remanentes spicas colligetis : sed pauperibus et peregrinis dimittetis eas. Ego sum Dominus Deus vester.
text_pt: E, quando fizerdes a colheita da vossa terra, não acabarás de segar os cantos do teu campo, nem colherás as espigas caídas da tua sega; para o pobre e para o estrangeiro as deixarás. Eu sou o Senhor vosso Deus.
text_el: καὶ ὅταν θερίζητε τὸν θερισμὸν τῆς γῆς ὑμῶν οὐ συντελέσετε τὸ λοιπὸν τοῦ θερισμοῦ τοῦ ἀγροῦ σου ἐν τῷ θερίζειν σε καὶ τὰ ἀποπίπτοντα τοῦ θερισμοῦ σου οὐ συλλέξεις τῷ πτωχῷ καὶ τῷ προσηλύτῳ ὑπολείψῃ αὐτά ἐγὼ κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses , saying:
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:
text_pt: E falou o Senhor a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: Say to the children of Israel : The seventh month, on the first day of the month, you shall keep a sabbath , a memorial, with the sound of trumpets, and it shall be called holy .
text_la: Loquere filiis Israël : Mense septimo, prima die mensis, erit vobis sabbatum, memoriale, clangentibus tubis, et vocabitur sanctum:
text_pt: Fala aos filhos de Israel, dizendo: No mês sétimo, ao primeiro do mês, tereis descanso, memorial com sonido de trombetas, santa convocação.
text_el: λάλησον τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ λέγων τοῦ μηνὸς τοῦ ἑβδόμου μιᾷ τοῦ μηνὸς ἔσται ὑμῖν ἀνάπαυσις μνημόσυνον σαλπίγγων κλητὴ ἁγία ἔσται ὑμῖν

text_en: You shall do no servile work therein, and you shall offer a holocaust to the Lord .
text_la: omne opus servile non facietis in eo, et offeretis holocaustum Domino.
text_pt: Nenhum trabalho servil fareis, mas oferecereis oferta queimada ao Senhor.
text_el: πᾶν ἔργον λατρευτὸν οὐ ποιήσετε καὶ προσάξετε ὁλοκαύτωμα κυρίῳ

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses , saying:
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:
text_pt: Falou mais o Senhor a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: Upon the tenth day of this seventh month shall be the day of atonement . It shall be most solemn , and shall be called holy : and you shall await your souls on that day, and shall offer a holocaust to the Lord .
text_la: Decimo die mensis hujus septimi, dies expiationum erit celeberrimus, et vocabitur sanctus : affligetisque animas vestras in eo, et offeretis holocaustum Domino.
text_pt: Mas aos dez dias desse sétimo mês será o dia da expiação; tereis santa convocação, e afligireis as vossas almas; e oferecereis oferta queimada ao Senhor.
text_el: καὶ τῇ δεκάτῃ τοῦ μηνὸς τοῦ ἑβδόμου τούτου ἡμέρα ἐξιλασμοῦ κλητὴ ἁγία ἔσται ὑμῖν καὶ ταπεινώσετε τὰς ψυχὰς ὑμῶν καὶ προσάξετε ὁλοκαύτωμα τῷ κυρίῳ

text_en: You shall do no servile work in the time of this day: because it is a day of propitiation, that the Lord your God may be merciful unto you.
text_la: Omne opus servile non facietis in tempore diei hujus : quia dies propitiationis est, ut propitietur vobis Dominus Deus vester.
text_pt: E naquele mesmo dia nenhum trabalho fareis, porque é o dia da expiação, para fazer expiação por vós perante o Senhor vosso Deus.
text_el: πᾶν ἔργον οὐ ποιήσετε ἐν αὐτῇ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ταύτῃ ἔστιν γὰρ ἡμέρα ἐξιλασμοῦ αὕτη ὑμῖν ἐξιλάσασθαι περὶ ὑμῶν ἔναντι κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ὑμῶν

text_en: Every soul that is not afflicted on this day, shall perish from among his people.
text_la: Omnis anima, quæ afflicta non fuerit die hac, peribit de populis suis:
text_pt: Porque toda a alma, que naquele mesmo dia se não afligir, será extirpada do seu povo.
text_el: πᾶσα ψυχή ἥτις μὴ ταπεινωθήσεται ἐν αὐτῇ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ταύτῃ ἐξολεθρευθήσεται ἐκ τοῦ λαοῦ αὐτῆς

text_en: And every soul that shall do any work, the same will I destroy from among his people.
text_la: et quæ operis quippiam fecerit, delebo eam de populo suo.
text_pt: Também toda a alma, que naquele mesmo dia fizer algum trabalho, eu a destruirei do meio do seu povo.
text_el: καὶ πᾶσα ψυχή ἥτις ποιήσει ἔργον ἐν αὐτῇ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ταύτῃ ἀπολεῖται ἡ ψυχὴ ἐκείνη ἐκ τοῦ λαοῦ αὐτῆς

text_en: You shall do no work therefore on that day: it shall be an everlasting ordinance unto you in all your generations , and dwellings.
text_la: Nihil ergo operis facietis in eo : legitimum sempiternum erit vobis in cunctis generationibus, et habitationibus vestris.
text_pt: Nenhum trabalho fareis; estatuto perpétuo é pelas vossas gerações em todas as vossas habitações.
text_el: πᾶν ἔργον οὐ ποιήσετε νόμιμον αἰώνιον εἰς τὰς γενεὰς ὑμῶν ἐν πάσαις κατοικίαις ὑμῶν

text_en: It is a sabbath of rest, and you shall afflict your souls beginning on the ninth day of the month. From evening until evening you shall celebrate your sabbaths .
text_la: Sabbatum requietionis est, et affligetis animas vestras die nono mensis : a vespera usque ad vesperam celebrabitis sabbata vestra.
text_pt: Sábado de descanso vos será; então afligireis as vossas almas; aos nove do mês à tarde, de uma tarde a outra tarde, celebrareis o vosso sábado.
text_el: σάββατα σαββάτων ἔσται ὑμῖν καὶ ταπεινώσετε τὰς ψυχὰς ὑμῶν ἀπὸ ἐνάτης τοῦ μηνὸς ἀπὸ ἑσπέρας ἕως ἑσπέρας σαββατιεῖτε τὰ σάββατα ὑμῶν

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses , saying:
text_la: Et locutus est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:
text_pt: E falou o Senhor a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: Say to the children of Israel : From the fifteenth day of this same seventh month, shall be kept the feast of tabernacles, seven days to the Lord .
text_la: Loquere filiis Israël : A quintodecimo die mensis hujus septimi, erunt feriæ tabernaculorum septem diebus Domino.
text_pt: Fala aos filhos de Israel, dizendo: Aos quinze dias deste mês sétimo será a festa dos tabernáculos ao Senhor por sete dias.
text_el: λάλησον τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ λέγων τῇ πεντεκαιδεκάτῃ τοῦ μηνὸς τοῦ ἑβδόμου τούτου ἑορτὴ σκηνῶν ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας τῷ κυρίῳ

text_en: The first day shall be called most solemn and most holy : you shall do no servile work therein. And seven days you shall offer holocausts to the Lord .
text_la: Dies primus vocabitur celeberrimus atque sanctissimus: omne opus servile non facietis in eo.
text_pt: Ao primeiro dia haverá santa convocação; nenhum trabalho servil fareis.
text_el: καὶ ἡ ἡμέρα ἡ πρώτη κλητὴ ἁγία πᾶν ἔργον λατρευτὸν οὐ ποιήσετε

text_en: The eighth day also shall be most solemn and most holy : and you shall offer holocausts to the Lord . For it is the day of assembly and congregation. You shall do no servile work therein.
text_la: Et septem diebus offeretis holocausta Domino. Dies quoque octavus erit celeberrimus, atque sanctissimus, et offeretis holocaustum Domino : est enim cœtus atque collectæ : omne opus servile non facietis in eo.
text_pt: Sete dias oferecereis ofertas queimadas ao Senhor; ao oitavo dia tereis santa convocação, e oferecereis ofertas queimadas ao Senhor; dia de proibição é, nenhum trabalho servil fareis.
text_el: ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας προσάξετε ὁλοκαυτώματα τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ ἡ ἡμέρα ἡ ὀγδόη κλητὴ ἁγία ἔσται ὑμῖν καὶ προσάξετε ὁλοκαυτώματα τῷ κυρίῳ ἐξόδιόν ἐστιν πᾶν ἔργον λατρευτὸν οὐ ποιήσετε

text_en: These are the feasts of the Lord which you shall call most solemn and most holy , and shall offer on them oblations to the Lord : holocausts and libations according to the rite of every day.
text_la: Hæ sunt feriæ Domini, quas vocabitis celeberrimas atque sanctissimas, offeretisque in eis oblationes Domino, holocausta et libamenta juxta ritum uniuscujusque diei:
text_pt: Estas são as solenidades do Senhor, que apregoareis para santas convocações, para oferecer ao Senhor oferta queimada, holocausto e oferta de alimentos, sacrifício e libações, cada qual em seu dia próprio;
text_el: αὗται αἱ ἑορταὶ κυρίῳ ἃς καλέσετε κλητὰς ἁγίας ὥστε προσενέγκαι καρπώματα τῷ κυρίῳ ὁλοκαυτώματα καὶ θυσίας αὐτῶν καὶ σπονδὰς αὐτῶν τὸ καθ' ἡμέραν εἰς ἡμέραν

text_en: Besides the sabbaths of the Lord , and your gifts, and those things that you offer by vow , or which you shall give to the Lord voluntarily.
text_la: exceptis sabbatis Domini, donisque vestris, et quæ offeretis ex voto, vel quæ sponte tribuetis Domino.
text_pt: Além dos sábados do Senhor, e além dos vossos dons, e além de todos os vossos votos, e além de todas as vossas ofertas voluntárias, que dareis ao Senhor.
text_el: πλὴν τῶν σαββάτων κυρίου καὶ πλὴν τῶν δομάτων ὑμῶν καὶ πλὴν πασῶν τῶν εὐχῶν ὑμῶν καὶ πλὴν τῶν ἑκουσίων ὑμῶν ἃ ἂν δῶτε τῷ κυρίῳ

text_en: So from the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when you shall have gathered in all the fruits of your land, you shall celebrate the feast of the Lord seven days. On the first day and the eighth shall be a sabbath : that is a day of rest.
text_la: A quintodecimo ergo die mensis septimi, quando congregaveritis omnes fructus terræ vestræ, celebrabitis ferias Domini septem diebus : die primo et die octavo erit sabbatum, id est, requies.
text_pt: Porém aos quinze dias do mês sétimo, quando tiverdes recolhido do fruto da terra, celebrareis a festa do Senhor por sete dias; no primeiro dia haverá descanso, e no oitavo dia haverá descanso.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τῇ πεντεκαιδεκάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ μηνὸς τοῦ ἑβδόμου τούτου ὅταν συντελέσητε τὰ γενήματα τῆς γῆς ἑορτάσετε τῷ κυρίῳ ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ πρώτῃ ἀνάπαυσις καὶ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ὀγδόῃ ἀνάπαυσις

text_en: And you shall take to you on the first day the fruits of the fairest tree, and branches of palm trees, and boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook: And you shall rejoice before the Lord your God .
text_la: Sumetisque vobis die primo fructus arboris pulcherrimæ, spatulasque palmarum, et ramos ligni densarum frondium, et salices de torrente, et lætabimini coram Domino Deo vestro.
text_pt: E no primeiro dia tomareis para vós ramos de formosas árvores, ramos de palmeiras, ramos de árvores frondosas, e salgueiros de ribeiras; e vos alegrareis perante o Senhor vosso Deus por sete dias.
text_el: καὶ λήμψεσθε τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ πρώτῃ καρπὸν ξύλου ὡραῖον καὶ κάλλυνθρα φοινίκων καὶ κλάδους ξύλου δασεῖς καὶ ἰτέας καὶ ἄγνου κλάδους ἐκ χειμάρρου εὐφρανθῆναι ἔναντι κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ὑμῶν ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας

text_en: And you shall keep the solemnity thereof seven days in the year. It shall be an everlasting ordinance in your generations . In the seventh month shall you celebrate this feast.
text_la: Celebrabitisque solemnitatem ejus septem diebus per annum : legitimum sempiternum erit in generationibus vestris. Mense septimo festa celebrabitis,
text_pt: E celebrareis esta festa ao Senhor por sete dias cada ano; estatuto perpétuo é pelas vossas gerações; no mês sétimo a celebrareis.
text_el: τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ νόμιμον αἰώνιον εἰς τὰς γενεὰς ὑμῶν ἐν τῷ μηνὶ τῷ ἑβδόμῳ ἑορτάσετε αὐτήν

text_en: And you shall dwell in bowers seven days. Every one that is of the race of Israel , shall dwell in tabernacles:
text_la: et habitabitis in umbraculis septem diebus : omnis, qui de genere est Israël, manebit in tabernaculis,
text_pt: Sete dias habitareis em tendas; todos os naturais em Israel habitarão em tendas;
text_el: ἐν σκηναῖς κατοικήσετε ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας πᾶς ὁ αὐτόχθων ἐν Ισραηλ κατοικήσει ἐν σκηναῖς

text_en: That your posterity may know, that I made the children of Israel to dwell in tabernacles, when I brought them out of the land of Egypt . I am the Lord your God .
text_la: ut discant posteri vestri quod in tabernaculis habitare fecerim filios Israël, cum educerem eos de terra Ægypti. Ego Dominus Deus vester.
text_pt: Para que saibam as vossas gerações que eu fiz habitar os filhos de Israel em tendas, quando os tirei da terra do Egito. Eu sou o Senhor vosso Deus.
text_el: ὅπως ἴδωσιν αἱ γενεαὶ ὑμῶν ὅτι ἐν σκηναῖς κατῴκισα τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ ἐν τῷ ἐξαγαγεῖν με αὐτοὺς ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου ἐγὼ κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν

text_en: And Moses spoke concerning the feasts of the Lord to the children of Israel .
text_la: Locutusque est Moyses super solemnitatibus Domini ad filios Israël.
text_pt: Assim pronunciou Moisés as solenidades do Senhor aos filhos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν Μωυσῆς τὰς ἑορτὰς κυρίου τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses , saying:
text_la: Et locutus est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:
text_pt: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: Command the children of Israel , that they bring unto you the finest and clearest oil of olives, to furnish the lamps continually,
text_la: Præcipe filiis Israël, ut afferant tibi oleum de olivis purissimum, ac lucidum, ad concinnandas lucernas jugiter,
text_pt: Ordena aos filhos de Israel que te tragam azeite de oliveira, puro, batido, para a luminária, para manter as lâmpadas acesas continuamente.
text_el: ἔντειλαι τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ καὶ λαβέτωσάν μοι ἔλαιον ἐλάινον καθαρὸν κεκομμένον εἰς φῶς καῦσαι λύχνον διὰ παντός

text_en: without the veil of the testimony in the tabernacle of the covenant . And Aaron shall set them from evening until morning before the Lord , by a perpetual service and rite in your generations .
text_la: extra velum testimonii in tabernaculo fœderis. Ponetque eas Aaron a vespere usque ad mane coram Domino, cultu rituque perpetuo in generationibus vestris.
text_pt: Arão as porá em ordem perante o Senhor continuamente, desde a tarde até à manhã, fora do véu do testemunho, na tenda da congregação; estatuto perpétuo é pelas vossas gerações.
text_el: ἔξωθεν τοῦ καταπετάσματος ἐν τῇ σκηνῇ τοῦ μαρτυρίου καύσουσιν αὐτὸν Ααρων καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ ἑσπέρας ἕως πρωὶ ἐνώπιον κυρίου ἐνδελεχῶς νόμιμον αἰώνιον εἰς τὰς γενεὰς ὑμῶν

text_en: They shall be set upon the most pure candlestick before the Lord continually.
text_la: Super candelabrum mundissimum ponentur semper in conspectu Domini.
text_pt: Sobre o candelabro de ouro puro porá em ordem as lâmpadas perante o Senhor continuamente.
text_el: ἐπὶ τῆς λυχνίας τῆς καθαρᾶς καύσετε τοὺς λύχνους ἔναντι κυρίου ἕως τὸ πρωί

text_en: You shall take also fine flour, and shall bake twelve loaves thereof, two tenths shall be in every loaf .
text_la: Accipies quoque similam, et coques ex ea duodecim panes, qui singuli habebunt duas decimas:
text_pt: Também tomarás da flor de farinha, e dela cozerás doze pães; cada pão será de duas dízimas de um efa.
text_el: καὶ λήμψεσθε σεμίδαλιν καὶ ποιήσετε αὐτὴν δώδεκα ἄρτους δύο δεκάτων ἔσται ὁ ἄρτος ὁ εἷς

text_en: And you shall set them six and six, one against another, upon the most clean table before the Lord .
text_la: quorum senos altrinsecus super mensam purissimam coram Domino statues:
text_pt: E os porás em duas fileiras, seis em cada fileira, sobre a mesa pura, perante o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιθήσετε αὐτοὺς δύο θέματα ἓξ ἄρτους τὸ ἓν θέμα ἐπὶ τὴν τράπεζαν τὴν καθαρὰν ἔναντι κυρίου

text_en: And you shall put upon them the clearest frankincense, that the bread may be for a memorial of the oblation of the Lord .
text_la: et pones super eos thus lucidissimum, ut sit panis in monimentum oblationis Domini.
text_pt: E sobre cada fileira porás incenso puro, para que seja, para o pão, por oferta memorial; oferta queimada é ao Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιθήσετε ἐπὶ τὸ θέμα λίβανον καθαρὸν καὶ ἅλα καὶ ἔσονται εἰς ἄρτους εἰς ἀνάμνησιν προκείμενα τῷ κυρίῳ

text_en: Every sabbath they shall be changed before the Lord : being received of the children of Israel by an everlasting covenant.
text_la: Per singula sabbata mutabuntur coram Domino suscepti a filiis Israël fœdere sempiterno:
text_pt: Em cada dia de sábado, isto se porá em ordem perante o Senhor continuamente, pelos filhos de Israel, por aliança perpétua.
text_el: τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῶν σαββάτων προθήσεται ἔναντι κυρίου διὰ παντὸς ἐνώπιον τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ διαθήκην αἰώνιον

text_en: And they shall be Aaron's and his sons', that they may eat them in the holy place: because it is most holy of the sacrifices of the Lord by a perpetual right.
text_la: eruntque Aaron et filiorum ejus, ut comedant eos in loco sancto : quia Sanctum sanctorum est de sacrificiis Domini jure perpetuo.
text_pt: E será de Arão e de seus filhos, os quais o comerão no lugar santo, porque uma coisa santíssima é para eles, das ofertas queimadas ao Senhor, por estatuto perpétuo.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται Ααρων καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτοῦ καὶ φάγονται αὐτὰ ἐν τόπῳ ἁγίῳ ἔστιν γὰρ ἅγια τῶν ἁγίων τοῦτο αὐτῷ ἀπὸ τῶν θυσιαζομένων τῷ κυρίῳ νόμιμον αἰώνιον

text_en: And behold there went out the son of a woman of Israel , whom she had of an Egyptian , among the children of Israel : and fell at words in the camp with a man of Israel .
text_la: Ecce autem egressus filius mulieris Israëlitidis, quem pepererat de viro ægyptio inter filios Israël, jurgatus est in castris cum viro Israëlita.
text_pt: E apareceu, no meio dos filhos de Israel o filho de uma mulher israelita, o qual era filho de um homem egípcio; e o filho da israelita e um homem israelita discutiram no arraial.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν υἱὸς γυναικὸς Ισραηλίτιδος καὶ οὗτος ἦν υἱὸς Αἰγυπτίου ἐν τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ καὶ ἐμαχέσαντο ἐν τῇ παρεμβολῇ ὁ ἐκ τῆς Ισραηλίτιδος καὶ ὁ ἄνθρωπος ὁ Ισραηλίτης

text_en: And when he had blasphemed the name , and had cursed it, he was brought to Moses . (Now his mother was called Salumith, the daughter of Dabri, of the tribe of Dan .)
text_la: Cumque blasphemasset nomen, et maledixisset ei, adductus est ad Moysen. (Vocabatur autem mater ejus Salumith, filia Dabri de tribu Dan.)
text_pt: Então o filho da mulher israelita blasfemou o nome do Senhor, e o amaldiçoou, por isso o trouxeram a Moisés; e o nome de sua mãe era Selomite, filha de Dibri, da tribo de Dã.
text_el: καὶ ἐπονομάσας ὁ υἱὸς τῆς γυναικὸς τῆς Ισραηλίτιδος τὸ ὄνομα κατηράσατο καὶ ἤγαγον αὐτὸν πρὸς Μωυσῆν καὶ τὸ ὄνομα τῆς μητρὸς αὐτοῦ Σαλωμιθ θυγάτηρ Δαβρι ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Δαν

text_en: And they put him into prison , till they might know what the Lord would command.
text_la: Miseruntque eum in carcerem, donec nossent quid juberet Dominus.
text_pt: E eles o puseram na prisão, até que a vontade do Senhor lhes pudesse ser declarada.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέθεντο αὐτὸν εἰς φυλακὴν διακρῖναι αὐτὸν διὰ προστάγματος κυρίου

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses ,
text_la: Qui locutus est ad Moysen,
text_pt: E falou o Senhor a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: saying: Bring forth the blasphemer without the camp: and let them that heard him, put their hands upon his head: and let all the people stone him.
text_la: dicens : Educ blasphemum extra castra, et ponant omnes qui audierunt, manus suas super caput ejus, et lapidet eum populus universus.
text_pt: Tira o que tem blasfemado para fora do arraial; e todos os que o ouviram porão as suas mãos sobre a sua cabeça; então toda a congregação o apedrejará.
text_el: ἐξάγαγε τὸν καταρασάμενον ἔξω τῆς παρεμβολῆς καὶ ἐπιθήσουσιν πάντες οἱ ἀκούσαντες τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ λιθοβολήσουσιν αὐτὸν πᾶσα ἡ συναγωγή

text_en: And you shall speak to the children of Israel : The man that curses his God , shall bear his sin :
text_la: Et ad filios Israël loqueris : Homo, qui maledixerit Deo suo, portabit peccatum suum;
text_pt: E aos filhos de Israel falarás, dizendo: Qualquer que amaldiçoar o seu Deus, levará sobre si o seu pecado.
text_el: καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ λάλησον καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτούς ἄνθρωπος ὃς ἐὰν καταράσηται θεόν ἁμαρτίαν λήμψεται

text_en: And he that blasphemes the name of the Lord , dying let him die. All the multitude shall stone him, whether he be a native or a stranger. He that blasphemes the name of the Lord , dying let him die.
text_la: et qui blasphemaverit nomen Domini, morte moriatur : lapidibus opprimet eum omnis multitudo, sive ille civis, sive peregrinus fuerit. Qui blasphemaverit nomen Domini, morte moriatur.
text_pt: E aquele que blasfemar o nome do Senhor, certamente morrerá; toda a congregação certamente o apedrejará; assim o estrangeiro como o natural, blasfemando o nome do Senhor, será morto.
text_el: ὀνομάζων δὲ τὸ ὄνομα κυρίου θανάτῳ θανατούσθω λίθοις λιθοβολείτω αὐτὸν πᾶσα συναγωγὴ Ισραηλ ἐάν τε προσήλυτος ἐάν τε αὐτόχθων ἐν τῷ ὀνομάσαι αὐτὸν τὸ ὄνομα κυρίου τελευτάτω

text_en: He that strikes and kills a man : dying let him die.
text_la: Qui percusserit, et occiderit hominem, morte moriatur.
text_pt: E quem matar a alguém certamente morrerá.
text_el: καὶ ἄνθρωπος ὃς ἂν πατάξῃ ψυχὴν ἀνθρώπου καὶ ἀποθάνῃ θανάτῳ θανατούσθω

text_en: He that kills a beast, shall make it good that is to say, shall give beast for beast.
text_la: Qui percusserit animal, reddet vicarium, id est, animam pro anima.
text_pt: Mas quem matar um animal, o restituirá, vida por vida.
text_el: καὶ ὃς ἂν πατάξῃ κτῆνος καὶ ἀποθάνῃ ἀποτεισάτω ψυχὴν ἀντὶ ψυχῆς

text_en: He that gives a blemish to any of his neighbours: as he has done, so shall it be done to him:
text_la: Qui irrogaverit maculam cuilibet civium suorum, sicut fecit, sic fiet ei:
text_pt: Quando também alguém desfigurar o seu próximo, como ele fez, assim lhe será feito:
text_el: καὶ ἐάν τις δῷ μῶμον τῷ πλησίον ὡς ἐποίησεν αὐτῷ ὡσαύτως ἀντιποιηθήσεται αὐτῷ

text_en: Breach for breach, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, shall he restore. What blemish he gave, the like shall he be compelled to suffer.
text_la: fracturam pro fractura, oculum pro oculo, dentem pro dente restituet : qualem inflixerit maculam, talem sustinere cogetur.
text_pt: Quebradura por quebradura, olho por olho, dente por dente; como ele tiver desfigurado a algum homem, assim se lhe fará.
text_el: σύντριμμα ἀντὶ συντρίμματος ὀφθαλμὸν ἀντὶ ὀφθαλμοῦ ὀδόντα ἀντὶ ὀδόντος καθότι ἂν δῷ μῶμον τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ οὕτως δοθήσεται αὐτῷ

text_en: He that strikes a beast, shall render another. He that strikes a man shall be punished.
text_la: Qui percusserit jumentum, reddet aliud. Qui percusserit hominem, punietur.
text_pt: Quem, pois, matar um animal, restitui-lo-á, mas quem matar um homem será morto.
text_el: ὃς ἂν πατάξῃ ἄνθρωπον καὶ ἀποθάνῃ θανάτῳ θανατούσθω

text_en: Let there be equal judgment among you, whether he be a stranger, or a native that offends: because I am the Lord your God .
text_la: Æquum judicium sit inter vos, sive peregrinus, sive civis peccaverit : quia ego sum Dominus Deus vester.
text_pt: Uma mesma lei tereis; assim será para o estrangeiro como para o natural; pois eu sou o Senhor vosso Deus.
text_el: δικαίωσις μία ἔσται τῷ προσηλύτῳ καὶ τῷ ἐγχωρίῳ ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν

text_en: And Moses spoke to the children of Israel . And they brought forth him that had blasphemed , without the camp: and they stoned him. And the children of Israel did as the Lord had commanded Moses .
text_la: Locutusque est Moyses ad filios Israël : et eduxerunt eum, qui blasphemaverat, extra castra, ac lapidibus oppresserunt. Feceruntque filii Israël sicut præceperat Dominus Moysi.
text_pt: E disse Moisés, aos filhos de Israel que levassem o que tinha blasfemado para fora do arraial, e o apedrejassem; e fizeram os filhos de Israel como o Senhor ordenara a Moisés.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν Μωυσῆς τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ καὶ ἐξήγαγον τὸν καταρασάμενον ἔξω τῆς παρεμβολῆς καὶ ἐλιθοβόλησαν αὐτὸν ἐν λίθοις καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ἐποίησαν καθὰ συνέταξεν κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses in mount Sinai , saying:
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen in monte Sinai, dicens:
text_pt: Falou mais o SENHOR a Moisés no monte Sinai, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν ἐν τῷ ὄρει Σινα λέγων

text_en: Speak to the children of Israel , and you shall say to them: When you shall have entered into the land which I will give you, observe the rest of the sabbath of the Lord .
text_la: Loquere filiis Israël, et dices ad eos : Quando ingressi fueritis terram quam ego dabo vobis, sabbatizes sabbatum Domino.
text_pt: Fala aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Quando tiverdes entrado na terra, que eu vos dou, então a terra descansará um sábado ao Senhor.
text_el: λάλησον τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτούς ἐὰν εἰσέλθητε εἰς τὴν γῆν ἣν ἐγὼ δίδωμι ὑμῖν καὶ ἀναπαύσεται ἡ γῆ ἣν ἐγὼ δίδωμι ὑμῖν σάββατα τῷ κυρίῳ

text_en: Six years you shall sow your field and six years you shall prune your vineyard, and shall gather the fruits thereof.
text_la: Sex annis seres agrum tuum, et sex annis putabis vineam tuam, colligesque fructus ejus:
text_pt: Seis anos semearás a tua terra, e seis anos podarás a tua vinha, e colherás os seus frutos;
text_el: ἓξ ἔτη σπερεῖς τὸν ἀγρόν σου καὶ ἓξ ἔτη τεμεῖς τὴν ἄμπελόν σου καὶ συνάξεις τὸν καρπὸν αὐτῆς

text_en: But in the seventh year there shall be a sabbath to the land, of the resting of the Lord . You shall not sow your field, nor prune your vineyard.
text_la: septimo autem anno sabbatum erit terræ, requietionis Domini : agrum non seres, et vineam non putabis.
text_pt: Porém ao sétimo ano haverá sábado de descanso para a terra, um sábado ao Senhor; não semearás o teu campo nem podarás a tua vinha.
text_el: τῷ δὲ ἔτει τῷ ἑβδόμῳ σάββατα ἀνάπαυσις ἔσται τῇ γῇ σάββατα τῷ κυρίῳ τὸν ἀγρόν σου οὐ σπερεῖς καὶ τὴν ἄμπελόν σου οὐ τεμεῖς

text_en: What the ground shall bring forth of itself, you shall not reap: neither shall you gather the grapes or the firstfruits as a vintage. For it is a year of rest to the land.
text_la: Quæ sponte gignet humus, non metes : et uvas primitiarum tuarum non colliges quasi vindemiam : annus enim requietionis terræ est:
text_pt: O que nascer de si mesmo da tua sega, não colherás, e as uvas da tua separação não vindimarás; ano de descanso será para a terra.
text_el: καὶ τὰ αὐτόματα ἀναβαίνοντα τοῦ ἀγροῦ σου οὐκ ἐκθερίσεις καὶ τὴν σταφυλὴν τοῦ ἁγιάσματός σου οὐκ ἐκτρυγήσεις ἐνιαυτὸς ἀναπαύσεως ἔσται τῇ γῇ

text_en: But they shall be unto you for meat, to you and to your manservant, to your maidservant and your hireling, and to the strangers that sojourn with you.
text_la: sed erunt vobis in cibum, tibi et servo tuo, ancillæ et mercenario tuo, et advenæ qui peregrinantur apud te:
text_pt: Mas os frutos do sábado da terra vos serão por alimento, a ti, e ao teu servo, e à tua serva, e ao teu diarista, e ao estrangeiro que peregrina contigo;
text_el: καὶ ἔσται τὰ σάββατα τῆς γῆς βρώματά σοι καὶ τῷ παιδί σου καὶ τῇ παιδίσκῃ σου καὶ τῷ μισθωτῷ σου καὶ τῷ παροίκῳ τῷ προσκειμένῳ πρὸς σέ

text_en: All things that grow shall be meat to your beasts and to your cattle.
text_la: jumentis tuis et pecoribus, omnia quæ nascuntur præbebunt cibum.
text_pt: E ao teu gado, e aos teus animais, que estão na tua terra, todo o seu produto será por mantimento.
text_el: καὶ τοῖς κτήνεσίν σου καὶ τοῖς θηρίοις τοῖς ἐν τῇ γῇ σου ἔσται πᾶν τὸ γένημα αὐτοῦ εἰς βρῶσιν

text_en: You shall also number to you seven weeks of years: that is to say, seven times seven, which together make forty-nine years.
text_la: Numerabis quoque tibi septem hebdomadas annorum, id est, septies septem, quæ simul faciunt annos quadraginta novem:
text_pt: Também contarás sete semanas de anos, sete vezes sete anos; de maneira que os dias das sete semanas de anos te serão quarenta e nove anos.
text_el: καὶ ἐξαριθμήσεις σεαυτῷ ἑπτὰ ἀναπαύσεις ἐτῶν ἑπτὰ ἔτη ἑπτάκις καὶ ἔσονταί σοι ἑπτὰ ἑβδομάδες ἐτῶν ἐννέα καὶ τεσσαράκοντα ἔτη

text_en: And you shall sound the trumpet in the seventh month, the tenth day of the month, in the time of the expiation in all your land.
text_la: et clanges buccina mense septimo, decima die mensis, propitiationis tempore, in universa terra vestra.
text_pt: Então no mês sétimo, aos dez do mês, farás passar a trombeta do jubileu; no dia da expiação fareis passar a trombeta por toda a vossa terra,
text_el: καὶ διαγγελεῖτε σάλπιγγος φωνῇ ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ ὑμῶν τῷ μηνὶ τῷ ἑβδόμῳ τῇ δεκάτῃ τοῦ μηνός τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ ἱλασμοῦ διαγγελεῖτε σάλπιγγι ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ ὑμῶν

text_en: And you shall sanctify the fiftieth year, and shall proclaim remission to all the inhabitants of your land: for it is the year of jubilee . Every man shall return to his possession, and every one shall go back to his former family :
text_la: Sanctificabisque annum quinquagesimum, et vocabis remissionem cunctis habitatoribus terræ tuæ : ipse est enim jubilæus. Revertetur homo ad possessionem suam, et unusquisque rediet ad familiam pristinam:
text_pt: E santificareis o ano qüinquagésimo, e apregoareis liberdade na terra a todos os seus moradores; ano de jubileu vos será, e tornareis, cada um à sua possessão, e cada um à sua família.
text_el: καὶ ἁγιάσετε τὸ ἔτος τὸ πεντηκοστὸν ἐνιαυτὸν καὶ διαβοήσετε ἄφεσιν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς πᾶσιν τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν αὐτήν ἐνιαυτὸς ἀφέσεως σημασία αὕτη ἔσται ὑμῖν καὶ ἀπελεύσεται εἷς ἕκαστος εἰς τὴν κτῆσιν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἕκαστος εἰς τὴν πατρίδα αὐτοῦ ἀπελεύσεσθε

text_en: Because it is the jubilee and the fiftieth year . You shall not sow, nor reap the things that grow in the field of their own accord, neither shall you gather the firstfruits of the vines,
text_la: quia jubilæus est, et quinquagesimus annus. Non seretis neque metetis sponte in agro nascentia, et primitias vindemiæ non colligetis,
text_pt: O ano qüinquagésimo vos será jubileu; não semeareis nem colhereis o que nele nascer de si mesmo, nem nele vindimareis as uvas das separações,
text_el: ἀφέσεως σημασία αὕτη τὸ ἔτος τὸ πεντηκοστὸν ἐνιαυτὸς ἔσται ὑμῖν οὐ σπερεῖτε οὐδὲ ἀμήσετε τὰ αὐτόματα ἀναβαίνοντα αὐτῆς καὶ οὐ τρυγήσετε τὰ ἡγιασμένα αὐτῆς

text_en: because of the sanctification of the jubilee . But as they grow you shall presently eat them.
text_la: ob sanctificationem jubilæi : sed statim oblata comedetis.
text_pt: Porque jubileu é, santo será para vós; a novidade do campo comereis.
text_el: ὅτι ἀφέσεως σημασία ἐστίν ἅγιον ἔσται ὑμῖν ἀπὸ τῶν πεδίων φάγεσθε τὰ γενήματα αὐτῆς

text_en: In the year of the jubilee all shall return to their possessions.
text_la: Anno jubilæi, redient omnes ad possessiones suas.
text_pt: Neste ano do jubileu tornareis cada um à sua possessão.
text_el: ἐν τῷ ἔτει τῆς ἀφέσεως σημασίᾳ αὐτῆς ἐπανελεύσεται ἕκαστος εἰς τὴν κτῆσιν αὐτοῦ

text_en: When you shall sell anything to your neighbour, or shall buy of him: grieve not your brother. But you shall buy of him according to the number of years from the jubilee .
text_la: Quando vendes quippiam civi tuo, vel emes ab eo, ne contristes fratrem tuum, sed juxta numerum annorum jubilæi emes ab eo,
text_pt: E quando venderdes alguma coisa ao vosso próximo, ou a comprardes da mão do vosso próximo, ninguém engane a seu irmão;
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἀποδῷ πρᾶσιν τῷ πλησίον σου ἐὰν καὶ κτήσῃ παρὰ τοῦ πλησίον σου μὴ θλιβέτω ἄνθρωπος τὸν πλησίον

text_en: And he shall sell to you according to the computation of the fruits.
text_la: et juxta supputationem frugum vendet tibi.
text_pt: Conforme ao número dos anos, desde o jubileu, comprarás ao teu próximo; e conforme o número dos anos das colheitas, ele a venderá a ti.
text_el: κατὰ ἀριθμὸν ἐτῶν μετὰ τὴν σημασίαν κτήσῃ παρὰ τοῦ πλησίον κατὰ ἀριθμὸν ἐνιαυτῶν γενημάτων ἀποδώσεταί σοι

text_en: The more years remain after the jubilee , the more shall the price increase: and the less time is counted, so much the less shall the purchase cost. For he shall sell to you the time of the fruits.
